key_turns: Turn 2 both attack (~20): block nearly all. Each BUTT 13 (the turn after any HISS) must be mostly blocked; HISS turns are free damage/power windows.

summary: Play Inflame then Inferno (self-damage ticks 6 AOE), Forgotten Ritual for energy. Kill Snapping Jaxfruit first, keep ~14 block per turn, save Flex potion for the boss.
key_turns: Turns 1-2 are free setup; afterwards ~14 damage arrives each turn—block it. When Flyconid shows VULNERABLE_SPORES (0 damage), dump everything into it.

summary: T1 Summon is free: Inflame then Inferno. Then Bash+ and attack Fogmog down; Inferno ticks 6 AOE when Bloodletting is played, clearing its summons. Keep enough block for 16 Headbutt.
key_turns: T1 Summon = free setup (Inflame, Inferno). Then Bash+ then attacks; Bloodletting ticks Inferno 6 AOE on summons; block the 16 Headbutt turns.

summary: Setup Inflame, Inferno, Barricade on the two charge turns; Bloodletting feeds Inferno for 24+ damage per turn. Block Plows, Bash+ into Colossus, push under 150 for the stun, save HP for Act 2.
key_turns: Plow 20-24 and Crush 17-18: full block. Break 150 for the free stun turn. Ringing turns: only your biggest card. Bash+ then Colossus halves its damage.

summary: Set up Inflame then Inferno; Bloodletting feeds Inferno's 6 AOE and refunds energy. Focus the Nectar bowlbug (it buffs into 18 hits). Block turn 1, then race — no Barricade, no Impervious here.
key_turns: T1 block 18 (15+3). T2 Nectar buffs — free damage window. T3 THRASH2 18 plus Rock's 15 (~33): full block or kill Nectar first. Rock attacks then stuns.

summary: Open with Inflame, Inferno, Bloodletting (each HP loss = 6 AOE; Baking Glove feeds free strength). Bash+ then Colossus halves damage; kill one Exoskeleton at a time through its 9-HP Hard to Kill revive.
key_turns: Turns after their buff intents: incoming ~3+8+9 plus accrued strength — block with Shrug It Off/Colossus (post Bash+ vulnerable). Finish 9-HP stragglers with Strikes/Pommel, not more AOE.

summary: Free T1: Inflame, Barricade, Inferno, Bloodletting. Then block the 23 and 17 hits with Barricade rolling block over, and grind the 121 HP down with Bash+ plus Baking Glove strength.
key_turns: T1 is free (buff): play all powers, Bloodletting feeds Inferno AOE. T2 Spike Explosion 23, T3 Tongue Lash 17: full block via Bash+ and Colossus; avoid Whirlwind while spikes are up.

summary: Block the 21/18 attack turns, set up Inflame+Inferno+Barricade on the T3 no-attack turn, then race with Bash+ vulnerable, Breakthrough and Bloodletting feeding Inferno; hold Shackling unless HP runs low.
key_turns: BEES 3x7 (T1/T4): block fully. SPEAR 18 (T2/T5): Colossus + block. PHEROMONE_SPIT turn (T3): free turn, deploy Barricade, Inferno, Inflame.

summary: Set up Inferno+Inflame turn 1; convert every HP loss (Bloodletting, Breakthrough, Inferno tick) into 6x4 AOE. Focus the lowest-HP attacker, expect a 9-HP revival per bug, hold Vulnerable potion for Knowledge Demon.
key_turns: T1-2: drop Inferno+Inflame, then Bloodletting/Breakthrough (each HP loss = 24 AOE). Every bug revives once at 9 HP — finish with Breakthrough (exactly 9). Block the 19+ incoming turns.

summary: Turn 1 is free: Inflame + Inferno (Lost Lantern zaps on each). Then race Obscura via Bash+/Whirlwind; Bloodletting/Breakthrough each add 6 AOE. Ignore Parafright, it revives; block attack turns. Rest heals afterward.
key_turns: T1 Summon: free turn, play powers. Then block the 9/13 attack turns; never attack Parafright (revives full, damage wasted). Drink Vulnerable potion on the Bash+/Whirlwind burst turn to close the kill.

summary: Set up Inflame, Inferno, Barricade on free curse turns; every HP loss (Bloodletting, Breakthrough, Inferno) deals 6 AOE. Fully block Slap and Overwhelming turns, then burst with Bash+ and Whirlwind during ponder turns so his 30-heal doesn'…
key_turns: T1/T5 curse turns: play powers free. T2 slap 19, T3 overwhelm 30 — full block. T4/T8 ponder heals 30: burst with vulnerable potion before heal.

summary: Normal slime fight: play Inflame T1-2, Thunderclap for AoE + vulnerable, pick up quick small-slime kills, then focus the medium twig slime while blocking its 11-damage pounces; exit via Burning Blood.
key_turns: T2 pounce 11+3+4: full block or kill small slimes first; pounces recur every other turn. Thunderclap early to give all vulnerable and boost every hit.

summary: Single 41-HP beetle: use the free debuff turn to play Inflame then Inferno, Spite doubles off the Inferno self-loss. Race it down by turn 3 so Stomp 13 never lands unblocked.
key_turns: T1 Shrinker hits for 0: play Inflame + Inferno (+Spite, doubled by the self-damage). T2 Chomp 7, T3 Stomp 13; kill by T3 or block fully that turn.

summary: Short race fight: Thunderclap strips Slippery 1 and applies Vulnerable on all three, then burst the 2x3 attacker, then the 16-HP one. Keep Mazaleth's Gift for The Kin boss.
key_turns: T1 Thunderclap first (strips Slippery, all get Vulnerable), kill the 2x3 attacker; next turn PIERCING_GAZE 10 from survivors — kill 1-2 now, block only if needed.

summary: Race: turn 1 Inferno (AOE chip each self-damage, doubles Spite) plus Thunderclap vulnerable. Focus the buffing Nibbit, block ~18 on T2–T3, keep Ritual potion for The Kin boss.
key_turns: T2–T3 are the danger: 13 plus 7 hits can land together; keep ~18 block or kill the buffing Nibbit first. After T4 Inferno chip finishes.

summary: Enemy buffs first, so play Inflame then Inferno, then burst with Bash+/Spite (Inferno's HP loss doubles Spite). Flame Barrier and weak cover the 9-11 and 22-damage turns; keep Ritual potion for The Kin boss.
key_turns: T1 enemy buffs: free setup. Thunderclap first strips Artifact 1, then Bash+. Block/weak REPEATER_BLAST and EXPEL 22 turns with Flame Barrier, Uppercut.

summary: Powers first: Inflame+ and Inferno by turn 2, then AOE both followers down with Thunderclap/Boomerang; block the 21-damage Beam turns; Ritual potion early for strength; Blood Potion only as emergency.
key_turns: Priest BEAM ~21 on T3/T7/T11 and after each RITUAL: hold 21+ block or Flame Barrier. Frailty/Weakness orbs cut block/damage, so pre-block extra on those turns.

summary: Race, not turtle: Inflame+ and Bash+ turn 1, add Inferno; swing turn 2 while it burrows; break the 32 burrow block next turn to stun it; kill by turn 4. Skip Demon Form — fight too short.
key_turns: Turn 2 (Burrow) is free — attack it, don't idle. Next turn it holds 32 block: dump ALL attacks to break it fully (stun, no 23). Never turtle; unbroken block = 23/turn.

summary: Race, don't turtle: Inflame+ then Inferno, clear with Thunderclap/Sword Boomerang+/Spite (doubles after Inferno's HP loss), focus the buffing bug. Keep HP for Kaiser Crab; skip Demon Form. Hold Fire potion, Blood potion emergency only.
key_turns: T1-2: buffer is harmless — Inflame+ and Inferno, spread AOE. T3+: two/three bugs attack ~17-25; full-block. Burst the buffer before its mandibles stack.

summary: T1 free (4 dmg): Inflame+ then Demon Form. Kill the 67-HP Myte first (it bites T2); block the 14s on T2/T3; then finish the second. Hold Fire potion for Kaiser Crab laser; Blood potion emergency.
key_turns: T1 is free (4 dmg): play Inflame+ then Demon Form. T2: 67-HP Myte bites 14 — kill it first or block fully. T3: other bites 14 + SUCK 4. Spare energy clears Toxin cards.

summary: Set up Demon Form+ and Inflames early, block the 21/18 attacks, use multi-hit attacks to minimize Dazed, then out-scale and kill. Hold Fire potion for boss unless HP < 25; Blood potion emergency.
key_turns: BEES/SPEAR turns (21/18): block fully. Buff turn (PHEROMONE_SPIT): deploy Demon Form+ and Inflames. Each attack adds Dazed—favor Sword Boomerang+/Spite, avoid Strikes. Potions if HP<25.

summary: Play Demon Form+ then Inflames while blocking; ramp Strength. Keep claw HPs even — never kill one alone (survivor gets +99 block, +6 Str). Kill both in one turn ~T8-10. Blood Potion only if HP low.
key_turns: Full-block Crusher's BUG_STING (weak2/frail2) and Rocket's charged LASER 41-49. Keep claw HPs within ~10; never solo-kill (rage +99 block +6 Str); double kill T8-10.

summary: Low incoming damage (4 now, 11 next): race the slimes. Play Stone Armor turn 1, kill the 12 HP twig slime first, then leaf slime, then medium. Spend no potions; save both for the Kin boss.
key_turns: T1: only 4 damage in — play Stone Armor, kill 12 HP twig. T2: block POKEY_POUNCE 11. Ignore GOOP/STICKY_SHOT; just clear Slimed.

summary: Use the free sleep+buff turns to land Stone Armor and Bash+ vulnerable, then race the statue while blocking ~23 Slash every turn; Flex on a multi-attack turn, skill potion only when a Slash would break us. Avoid dragging past ~8 turns.
key_turns: T1 Sleep: powers only, no attacks (don't wake early). T2 Wake/buff: Bash+ then attack freely, it doesn't hit. From T3 Slashes 23 every turn: block fully, dump attacks on Slow-stacked turns.

summary: Race both slugs: Bash for vulnerable on the 27 HP slug, Breakthrough hits both, focus one down while blocking the ~19 turn 2. Save Speed potion unless HP drops low.
key_turns: Turn 2 brings ~19 (9+10) — block it fully. Later GLOMP hits for 10. Kill one slug before slug 2's second cycle; Breakthrough's AOE is worth the 1 HP.

summary: Simple race: Bash first for vulnerable, then dump Unrelenting/Headbutt/Strike. Block only the 12 SLAM to save HP for the boss; keep both potions.
key_turns: T1 Oil Spray 8+weak; SLAM 12 turn: full block; RAGE buff turn is the free damage window. Kill by turn 3-4 before weak stacks.

summary: Race: play Inferno turn 1; concentrate all damage on one gardener at a time (biggest hit first), use Breakthrough while all four are alive, and block only when a turn's incoming exceeds 20.
key_turns: Incoming 15 now, grows to 27+ as ENLARGE stacks; kill one gardener every 1-2 turns, and on any turn with 20+ incoming block instead of attacking.

summary: Race an 82-HP fog dealing only 5-8/turn: turn 1 Inferno (plus Bash+ if energy allows), then attacks with minimal blocking. Finish in about 4 turns, no potions, keeping HP for the Matriarch.
key_turns: Incoming is only 5-8 per turn: block just enough, spend the rest on damage. Play Inferno turn 1; if Bloat clogs the draw pile with status cards, finish before it stacks.

summary: Play Inferno turn 1, then Bash+ the Cultist and kill it first while blocking the Seapunk; Breakthrough/Stomp are worth it while both live (Inferno makes each self-damage 15 AOE). Keep Lucky Tonic for the boss.
key_turns: T1 Cultist only buffs: play Inferno. Turns 2-4 Cultist hits 10+ scaling — kill it first; block Seapunk's 11/9. Don't let both scale: finish by ~T5.

summary: Inferno turn 1 for free AoE each HP loss, then Breakthrough/Stomp to kill all three slugs together so none inherits +4 Strength. Keep both potions for the Matriarch two floors away; block only when incoming exceeds ~15.
key_turns: T1 play Inferno; T2-T4 stack Breakthrough + Stomp to drop all three slugs the same turn (Ravenous +4 Str per death). If HP < ~40, spend Shrug It Off/Defend instead of chipping.

summary: Play Inferno during the 3 sleep turns, blocking and drawing but not waking the boss. Once it wakes, block the 19-21 hits, use Breakthrough to trigger Inferno AoE, and chip 233 HP before SOUL_SIPHON stacks.
key_turns: Sleep turns 1-3: setup only, no damage past 12 block. Waking stun turn and DISEMBOWEL 21/SLASH 19 turns: full block + potion. SOUL_SIPHON: free damage.

summary: Free first turn: play Inflame and Stampede, then race the 42 HP beetle down before Shrink plus its 7/13 hits cost HP. Save both potions for the Act 1 boss.
key_turns: T1 is 0-damage SHRINKER: play Inflame then Stampede. After Shrink lands, kill the 42 HP beetle fast; block CHOMP 7/STOMP 13; no potions.

summary: T1-2 free (INFECT): Inflame, Stampede, then attack. Block 16 LASH turns. Race parasite (68 HP) - after it splits, AOE then kill worms one by one before their strength and Infection stack.
key_turns: Free INFECT turns: play powers, attack. LASH 16: block it. After split: Stomp at 3+ worms, then focus one worm; every other turn they buff and add Infection.

summary: Race: kill worms one by one, weakest first — each dead worm cuts 8+ per bite turn and stops its strength/Infection. Use free turns for pure offense; block only on bite turns. Win by turn 4.
key_turns: Stun/buff turns: full offense; play 2 attacks then Stomp (costs 1). Bite turns 32/40+: Blood Wall + kill weakest worm; Dexterity potion if 3+ still bite.

summary: Rush the bird before strength stacks: Inflame turn 1, Bash for vulnerable, then Dismantle/Sword Boomerang/Whirlwind with strength. Block only the 18+ Swoop turns; dexterity potion on that big hit. Kill by ~turn 4, tanking small pecks.
key_turns: Swoop turns (18+ and climbing with its +STR): full block with Blood Wall/Defends, potion there. If lethal is reachable, skip blocking and finish.

summary: Inflame and Stampede turn 1 (only 6 damage incoming), then race: Bash for Vulnerable, cash with Dismantle/Twin Strike/Whirlwind, block the 13-damage BUTT turns. Keep acid potion as HP insurance for Vantom.
key_turns: T2-T4: both BUTT 13s can land together (~26) — block fully. Kill the buffing Nibbit first; Bash then Dismantle converts Vulnerable into 16.

summary: Free first turns: Inflame + Stampede, strip Slippery with multi-hits, Bash then Dismantle. Survive T3/T7 Dismember with full block; burst on PREPARE turns. Target ~22 damage/turn to finish near T6-8.
key_turns: T3/T7 DISMEMBER 27 + 3 wounds: full block (Blood Wall/Colossus), don't trade. T4/T8 PREPARE: dump damage and Bash-vulnerable. Use multi-hit (Whirlwind/Twin Strike/Boomerang) to strip the 9 Slippery e…

summary: Race the Tunneler: Inflame turn 1, Bash for vulnerable, burst multi-hits on the no-attack burrow turn to break the 32 block and stun, then finish before BELOW 23s grind us. Save Ashwater.
key_turns: T2 BURROW: no attack — dump everything to break the 32 block (stuns it). T3+ BELOW 23/turn: block or kill fast; turtling into repeated 23s loses.

summary: Race the 84 HP Hopper: Inflame turn 1, then Bash into Twin Strike/Sword Boomerang/Dismantle to kill within ~4 turns before it steals and escapes. Block the 17/21 hit turns; Burning Blood heals 6 after.
key_turns: This THIEVERY 17 turn: block to ≥20 HP, still play Inflame. FLUTTER buff turn = full offense. Block HAT_TRICK 21/NAB 14. Kill before the ESCAPE turn or a card is lost.

summary: Set up Inflame and Bash for vulnerability on turn 1, burst with Twin Strike/Sword Boomerang before thorns exist. Full block the 23 and 17 hit turns; avoid multi-hits while spiky. Save HP for the Act 2 boss.
key_turns: T1 free buff turn: Inflame+Bash then burst multi-hits (no thorns yet). T2: Colossus+Blood Wall vs 23. T3: block 17. During thorns use only single-hit attacks.

summary: Race the Obscura: turn 1 free, play Inflame then Bash; all damage on the 129 HP boss, never attack the Parafright (it revives full). Block T4-5 with Colossus/Flame Barrier and finish by turn 5.
key_turns: T1 is free (Summon): Inflame+Bash, no block needed. T3-T5 Hardening Strike 22-25 plus Parafright: Colossus/Flame Barrier/Blood Wall, burst to kill by T5.

summary: Play Inflame turn 1 with Hot Cocoa energy, Bash the Nectar, then use Breakthrough/Whirlwind AOE to clear the group fast while blocking the Rock's 15; hold both potions for the Kaiser Crab boss.
key_turns: T1 Rock headbutt 15 — block it; Nectar buffs, then thrashes 18/turn, so kill Nectar first; Egg (23hp) folds to AOE.

summary: Race: Inflame turn 1 using Hot Cocoa energy, then AOE (Stomp/Whirlwind/Breakthrough) to clear all four; block only heavy attack turns; end fight fast and keep 72+ HP for Kaiser Crab.
key_turns: Turns where 3-4 bugs attack (≈27+ incoming): full block with Blood Wall/Flame Barrier; finish any bug at low HP to stop Mandibles; worst case is all four enraged.

summary: Ramp Inflame x2 (Hot Cocoa T1), Bash for vulnerable, then even both claws with AoE and kill them the same turn; never lone-kill. Energy potion on laser/kill turn; Ashwater dumps junk cards.
key_turns: T3 Bug Sting weak+frail; T4 Rocket Laser 41-49: hold Flame Barrier+Colossus (after Bash) or Blood Wall. Keep claws within ~10 HP; burst both in one AoE turn.

summary: Kill one slug fast (Breakthrough hits both; Twin Strike/Bash finish), blocking Glomp/Whip Slap turns; Goop turns are free. Save Mazaleth's Gift for the boss sleep turns — free Ritual; ampoule whenever it kills or saves HP.
key_turns: Now 3×2 + 8 = 14; Whip Slap 9 and Glomp 10 stack (~19) — block fully those turns. Goop turns are free hits.

summary: Race the clam before PRESSURIZE stacks: open Battle Trance for cards, keep Vulnerable up, block the JET hits, finish with Cinder. Keep HP for the boss; save both potions for elite/boss.
key_turns: PRESSURIZE turns (no attack): dump Cinder/Bash/damage. JET turns (10-13): block with Defends/Taunt. Apply Vulnerable first so hits punch through Plating 9.

summary: Race: deck has no scaling. Battle Trance first, Taunt strips Artifact, Bash+ Vulnerable, then burst on READY turns. Hold Mazaleth's Gift for the Matriarch boss's long fight.
key_turns: READY turns deal 0 damage — unload fully. Block the FAST_PUNCH 10 and STRONG_PUNCH 14 turns; strip Artifact with Taunt before Bash+ Vulnerable.

summary: Pure race: Battle Trance+ into Bash+ and heavy hits (Bludgeon, Perfected Strike ~24, Cinder) to kill in 3–4 turns. Block the 12–13 attack with Defend/Taunt when needed; keep the Ritual potion for the Matriarch.
key_turns: No setup turns: it attacks 12–13 every turn. Bash+ early to amplify Bludgeon/Cinder; kill by turn 4. Don't end below ~25 HP for the boss path.

summary: Race: Battle Trance+ into Bash+ Vulnerable, then Bludgeon/Perfected Strike and Twin Strike to kill its 67 HP fast. Block the STOMP/SWIPE turns, take little damage, save both potions for the elite/boss.
key_turns: Turn 1 HAUNT adds statuses, so Battle Trance first and Bash+ Vulnerable; then block/out-race the 12-13 SWIPE/STOMP turns. Kill by turn 3-4 before statuses clog the hand.

summary: No powers to set up: race. Breakthrough hits all three; Bash+ then Bludgeon kills the caller. Hold Mazaleth's Gift for the boss; Block Potion only if HP dips.
key_turns: Kill the backup-caller (22 HP, Debuff) before it summons; SCREECH turns are free damage; when bite+scratch land together (14), block to near zero.

summary: No powers to set up, so race. Sleep turns T1-3: play only Brand and Battle Trance+, never hit into 12 plating. From T4, Bash+ for Vulnerable then Bludgeon bursts; keep Flame Barrier+ and block potion for her 21-22 damage turns.
key_turns: While she sleeps (T1-3): no attacks, 12 plating refreshes. From T4: Bash+ Vulnerable then Bludgeon burst; full-block SLASH 21 / DISEMBOWEL 11x2 turns; Soul Siphon turn is the free attack turn.

summary: Race the hopper: Brand free, then Bludgeon/Pommel/Perfected Strike all-out to kill in ~4-5 turns before it escapes with stolen cards; block only the 21 turn.
key_turns: HAT_TRICK 21 (T3) and THIEVERY 17: block only if lethal not available; kill before ESCAPE around T5-6.

summary: Kill one bug per turn: powers first (Stone Armor, Unmovable), Breakthrough with all three alive, focus lowest/buffing bug; block when two-plus attack; hold strength potion for Kaiser Crab boss.
key_turns: T1-2 play powers while hit is 11; once 2-3 enrage (~20-27/turn) full block unless a kill removes an attacker; Breakthrough only with 3 alive; Bludgeon as finisher; stay high for boss.

summary: Play Stone Armor + Unmovable on the free T1, then block the 23/17 cycle and kill with Bludgeon, Bash+ and single hits; never Twin Strike while thorns are up. Save the strength potion for Kaiser Crab.
key_turns: T1 is free (buff, 0 incoming): play powers. T2 Spike Explosion 23 and each cycle repeat: full block. T3 Tongue Lash 17: block ~17. While its thorns are up, single-hit attacks only (no Twin Strike).

summary: Race the 4-bug swarm with AOE: Stone Armor early, then Breakthrough/Thunderclap+/Exterminate to even HP and finish one bug per turn. Save strength potion for Kaiser Crab. Block Mandible turns, keep 65+ HP.
key_turns: T1 only ~19 incoming: play powers then AOE. Kill one bug per turn, buffing/lowest HP first. T2-4 Mandibles ~9x4 after Enrage: block fully, Flame Barrier reflects.

summary: Race: kill Nectar first (it hits 18/turn after its buff), then Rock; Egg falls to AOE. Block T1's 25 and T3's 40; Stone Armor/Unmovable on the free T2. Save strength potion for Kaiser Crab unless in trouble.
key_turns: T1 ~25 incoming: block it. T2 Rock stunned, Nectar buffing = free: install powers and hurt Nectar. T3 40 incoming if Nectar lives: kill it first or Unmovable-block that turn.

summary: Race one chomper at a time. Turn 1: Unmovable/Stone Armor while only 16 incoming, then block each clamp turn and dump the rest into damage; Strength Potion on a multi-hit burst turn; clear statuses so block keeps flowing.
key_turns: One chomper clamps (16) every turn — block it; SCREECH turns add 3 statuses, exhaust with Brand/Stoke+. Kill the first chomper before the deck clogs.

summary: Long fight: play Unmovable/Brand/Stone Armor early, keep both claws' HP even with AOE, block the T3 debuff and T4 laser, then dump strength-scaled AOE with the Energy potion to kill both claws in one turn.
key_turns: T3 BUG_STING (Weak2/Frail2) and T4 LASER 41-49: full block, Flame Barrier+ first under Unmovable; spend Energy potion only on the turn both claws die together.

summary: Race the 59 HP crawler: Battle Trance turn 1, Bash for vulnerable then Strikes. Block only the big acid hits, eat small pokes; no potions held, HP 67 is comfortable. Skip Dark Embrace.
key_turns: Acid Goop turns (12, higher after Inhale) are the block turns — Flame Barrier/Defends; Inhale turn is free damage. Small 4-7 pokes can be eaten.

summary: Four 18-22 HP worms, no AOE: race them. Battle Trance turn 1, then kill one per turn lowest HP first; Flame Barrier/Defends cover the bite turns. Infections pile up if it drags past ~5 turns.
key_turns: Worms that WRIGGLE hit for 10+ next turn and every cycle grow +2; kill one worm per turn (lowest HP first), block just enough on double-bite turns; never spend a whole turn only defending.

summary: Race the 46 HP Nibbit: Bash+ turn 1 for vulnerable, then Twin Strike+/Strikes. Block only the 12-13 attacks, skip Flame Barrier if it dies first; preserve HP for the elite next.
key_turns: BUTT 13 hit (this turn): block with Shrug It Off+ or Flame Barrier so net HP loss is small; HISS buff turn = free full damage; kill by turn 3-4.

summary: Race Byrdonis: turn 1 Battle Trance then Bash+ for vulnerable, follow with Twin Strike+/Pommel/Strikes. Skip Dark Embrace; block only the biggest hits; finish by turn 5 with most HP intact.
key_turns: Strength +1 each turn; hits reach 22+ by turn 5. Frontload damage every turn, use Shrug It Off+/Defends on SWOOP turns, kill by turn 5.

summary: Race Vantom: break 9 Slippery with Twin Strike+/Thunderclap, keep Bash+ vulnerable up, stack attacks for Gilded Fan block, full-block Dismember turns, burst on Prepare turns. Skip Dark Embrace.
key_turns: Dismember turns (3rd, 7th): full block, use block potion if short; Prepare turns (4th, 8th): unload all damage; never play Dark Embrace (no exhaust cards).

summary: Race: Bash+ turn 1 for vulnerable, then Battle Trance into Twin Strike+/Pommel/Strikes plus Feed; kill in 3-4 turns before it steals a card and flees. Save Swift Potion for the boss.
key_turns: T3 HAT_TRICK 21 plus card steal — kill before it or block fully; must be dead by T4, it escapes T5 with the stolen card.

summary: Bash+ then race Nectar (36 HP, hits 18) while Rock's 15 headbutts are blocked; use Rock's stun turn as the free kill window, then grind Rock slowly. Save Swift potion for the boss.
key_turns: T1: block Rock's 15 while Bashing Nectar. T2: Rock stunned, Nectar buffs/big hits — burst Nectar down. Later block only on Rock's headbutt turns; kill during stun.

summary: Turn 1: play Fight Me! for permanent +3 strength, then Bash the Myte that bites next. Kill Myte1 first, block every BITE turn fully, spend spare energy clearing Toxin, stay above 25 HP.
key_turns: This turn is nearly free (Myte1 TOXIC, Myte2 only 4) — play Fight Me!. Next turn is Myte1's BITE ~14: full block. Use spare energy on 毒素 cards.

summary: Short race: Fight Me+Battle Trance on the free T1-T2 turns, Bash+ then multi-hits; block fully on Pounce turns; Feed finishes for +3 max HP; keep Swift potion for the Insatiable boss.
key_turns: T3/T6 POUNCE 20+strength: full block, no greedy damage. T2/T5 CURL_AND_GROW: no attack, set up and chip its block. Burst only after Bash+ vulnerability.

summary: Ignore eggs entirely; every point of damage goes at the Ovicopter so the minions vanish with it. Ramp strength and Vulnerable on the free turns, block the 19 SMASH hits, kill by ~turn 5-6, save potions for the boss.
key_turns: Turn 1 Summon is free: Fight Me/Bash+/Battle Trance, all damage to the body. Block the SMASH 19 turns (T2, T5); Tenderizer 7 turns are safe to attack through.

summary: Race on the free T1: Fight Me! for permanent strength, Battle Trance to dig, dump attacks (no thorns yet). Fully block the 23 and 17 hits; while thorns are up favor single big hits. Save Swift potion for the boss.
key_turns: T1 (Buff, no attack/thorns): Fight Me!+Battle Trance then all attacks. T2 Spike Explosion 23: full block, Flame Barrier+. T3 Tongue Lash 17: block; single-hit attacks while thorns up.

summary: Race the 341 HP clock: free T1 plays Pyre+ and Fight Me!, Baked Gloves stacks strength each turn, Bash+ into Molten Fist for 6 vulnerable, then burst with Bludgeon/Twin Strike; block the 29 bites.
key_turns: T1 free: Pyre+ then Fight Me!. T2-3 block LUNGING_BITE 29. Sandpit ≤2: play Frantic Escape first every time — never get swallowed.

summary: Hallway sculptor scales +9/turn: burst it by turn 4. T1 is free — Axe-doubled Fight Me! for +6 strength, Crimson Mantle, Pyre+; after that Bludgeon/Twin Strike while blocking 15-20 per turn. No potions held.
key_turns: T3–T4: SAVAGE 21/30 — block 20+ with Flame Barrier+/Shrug+; race, kill by T4 (T5 = 39). T1 free: Axe-doubled Fight Me!, Crimson Mantle, Pyre+.

summary: Kill the buffing scroll first, then one per turn, while powers go up: Pyre+ energy, Crimson Mantle+ block, Fight Me!/Rupture strength for Bludgeon. Feed every killing blow for +3 max HP. Hold the skill potion unless HP gets low.
key_turns: Axe doubles your first card — lead with Pyre+ or Flame Barrier+. T1-T2 incoming 24. Kill the buffing scroll first; Feed for last hits. Don't let MORE_TEETH stack.

summary: Axe: play an attack first (Fight Me→+6 Str, else Bludgeon). Then Rupture + Crimson Mantle+ (Str + 10 block/turn), Pyre+ for energy. Block T4/T7 cleaves, burst-kill by T9.
key_turns: T3 WINDUP (no attack): play powers, bank block for T4. T4/T7 HEAVY_CLEAVE 42+: full block, Flame Barrier, skill potion if short. Kill by T9.

summary: Strip Artifact (Bash/Taunt) then double Vulnerable with Molten Fist. Stack Rupture+Mantle+Glove strength; exhaust Withers with Pact. Never attack into Ebb's 33 block; kill by T8 with Bludgeon burst.
key_turns: T2/T5/T8: boss 33 block + Eye Lasers ~28-40 incoming — block hard, play powers, no attacks. T3/T6: no incoming, dump Bludgeon; T4/T7 block Ebb while attacking.

summary: No powers to set up, so race: hit hard on T1, kill twig slime then small leaf slime, then grind the medium's 36 HP while blocking its 8-hits. Expect ~10-15 HP cost; save Blood Potion for boss/elite.
key_turns: T1 only 4 incoming — attack freely. T2: 8+4+3=15 if all alive; kill both small slimes first so only the 8 remains; block chip, don't overblock.

summary: No powers; race the 67 HP trio with AOE: Howl 18 to all, Breakthrough 9 to all, Spite doubles after Breakthrough's self-damage. Kill Crossbow first (biggest hit, lowest HP); block only the spike turn; finish by T3.
key_turns: T1 only 5 incoming: Howl (18 all) or Bash+Breakthrough+Spite. T2 spike ~27 (FIRE 14 + HOUNDS 8 + swing) if Crossbow lives; kill it or full-block.

summary: No powers to set up: race the Strangler before Constrict drains HP. Open Howl (wipes slimes, 18 to Strangler), Bash+ for vulnerable, Flame Barrier on Lash turns. Hold both potions.
key_turns: Constrict ticks each turn, so Strangler must die by ~T3-4. Block Lash 12 with Flame Barrier/Toric Toughness. T1 Howl wipes both slimes.

summary: Rupture on the safe INFECT turn; block LASH 16 turns with Flame Barrier. Bash+ the parasite; after the split use Howl+Breakthrough AOE, focusing one worm at a time, keeping HP for the Kin boss.
key_turns: Rupture on safe INFECT turns; LASH 16 turns need full block (Flame Barrier). After the split worms hit ~4x8: nuke with Howl+Breakthrough, focus one worm at a time.

summary: Race: this stun turn is free - Howl 18 to all four, next turn Breakthrough finishes the <=4 HP swarm; skip Rupture/block, kill lowest-HP worms first, stay near full HP for the Kin boss.
key_turns: T1 all worms stunned: Howl 18 to all, don't block; T2 Breakthrough wipes the <=4 HP swarm. Else kill lowest-HP worm first; never eat 4 bites (32).

summary: Race: kill beetle first (stops Shrink, 13 STOMP) while Breakthroughs/Howl clear both. Turn 1 free—Anchor eats 4—Rupture if no lethal available. Save Blood potion for emergencies; block the post-INHALE acid turn.
key_turns: T1 is free (4 in, Anchor 10): Rupture/attacks. Kill beetle before its 13 STOMP. Crawler INHALE turn is free damage; the turn after, block ~25 boosted acid + beetle.

summary: Race: Slippery 1 wastes each enemy's first hit, so lead small Breakthrough then bigger AOE to kill all three fast. Play Inflame only if lethal holds; save Blood Potion for the boss.
key_turns: T1: chain all Breakthroughs, pop each Slippery with the smallest hit — usually kills all three. T2 gaze turn (10 each, up to 26): finish or block fully, no HP trading.

summary: Set up Rupture+Inflame turns 1-2; use Breakthroughs/Howl to AOE both followers down before their strength snowballs, then grind the priest. Block beams fully, drink Blood Potion only if low; keep HP for act 2.
key_turns: T2/T6/T10 BEAM (~13+str, 3 hits): full block, Flame Barrier; T3/T7 RITUAL free—dump AOE; clear both followers by T5-6.

summary: Race: Inflame+ first for +3 strength, then Breakthrough+ x2, Spite (10 after self-damage) and Howl to drop both bugs by turn 3. Block only the double-attack turns; both potions stay for the boss.
key_turns: T1 take 18; T2 nectar buffs (no damage) - kill both by T3 before 15+18; block T3 or finish.

summary: Race: 32 burrow block persists, so damage is never wasted. Inflame+/Rupture/Brand+ on the free burrow turn, break the block in two turns to stun, then burn down while blocking BITE 13 / BELOW 23.
key_turns: T2 BURROW is free: play powers and attack into its 32 block. Break the block within two turns to stun it; then block the recurring BELOW 23 while racing.

summary: Race: Inflame+/Rupture/Brand+ early, then Breakthroughs, Howl, Stomp to clear egg and nectar before the T3 40-damage turn; block T1; Blood Potion only if HP dips below 30.
key_turns: T1 25 incoming: block with anchor+Flame Barrier. T2 rock stunned & nectar buffs: free all-in, kill egg+nectar. T3 back to 15+7+18: finish or big block.

summary: 23 HP race: T1 Inflame+ and Rupture behind Anchor's 10 block, hold ~16 block each turn, use AOE (Breakthrough+ x2, Howl, Stomp) to kill both Chompers; kill the 64 HP one first; drink Blood Potion early.
key_turns: All turns ~16 alternating 8x2; block ~16/turn, never eat two unblocked hits. Screech/status turns are windows for AOE and powers; after one dies incoming halves — finish.

summary: Kill the Ovicopter body fast: powers turn 1-2, then all damage on it — eggs die with it. Never attack eggs. Block SMASH 19 with Shrug/Flame Barrier/Defends, spend the block potion only if HP drops low.
key_turns: LAY_EGGS/SMASH turns: ignore eggs, dump Breakthroughs/Howl/Stomp into the body. On SMASH 19 (and TENDERIZER 7 follow-up) hold a full block line; keep HP for the boss.

summary: Play Inflame+, Rupture, Brand+ in the first two turns (incoming is only 4-14), then race both Mytes with Breakthrough+/Howl/Stomp AoE. Prioritize the one that bites next; keep Flame Barrier/Shrug for the double-attack turns and block potio…
key_turns: T2 bite 14; T3-T4 both attack (~28): full block + block potion. Kill the TOXIC Myte before its bite; spend spare energy dumping toxin.

summary: Stack Rupture, Inflame+, Brand+ during the free buff turns, then race ~46/turn: full block the 29 LUNGING_BITE, play Frantic Escape whenever sandpit drops to 2, save fire potion to close the kill.
key_turns: Turn 1-2 buffs are free: play Rupture/Inflame+/Brand+. LUNGING_BITE ~29: full block. Sandpit ≤2: Frantic Escape first. Fire potion on final burst turn.

summary: Race the 49 HP Sea Punk. Bash first to enable vuln, then dump damage; eat the 11/9 rather than over-block. Hold Feed as the killing blow around the buff turn for permanent +3 max HP.
key_turns: T1 11 / T2 9: block only if free, else race face. T3 Bubble Burp deals 0 — ideal kill turn: finish with Feed for +3 max HP.

summary: Race the pair: feed-kill the buffing toad turn 1, then AoE and clean up the survivor; eat at most one 7-9 attack, stay high for the forced rest and act-1 elite path.
key_turns: T1 Bash then Feed kills the buffing toad (+3 max HP). Afterwards expect 7-9 hits per turn; Breakthrough/Thunderclap to finish the survivor, Defends if it lives.

summary: Race the 4 gardeners: focus-fire lowest HP first (27→30→31→32), biggest hit first since skittish blocks only after the first card. Hold Feed+ to land a killing blow (+4 max HP).
key_turns: Turns after ENLARGE (~27 incoming): block fully, drink Skill Potion if short. Kill one enemy every 1-2 turns; never spread damage, never let HP drop under 20.

summary: Thunderclap first (vuln all), then Breakthrough hits all for ~17; finish rats one per turn with Feed+/Twin Strike for +4 max HP. Block only on turns all three attack; save Lucky Tonic for an HP emergency.
key_turns: Rats cycle 0/6/8 dmg; when all three attack (~20) hold full block instead of trading. Turns with only a Screech (0 dmg) are free damage turns; kill one rat per turn, Feed+ last hit.

summary: 26 HP, no powers: block >=14 every turn, kill lowest-HP slug first (Feed+ last hit for +4 max HP), Buffer only if a turn would drop us near death; shop next, rest before boss.
key_turns: T2 all three attack (~28): full block, zero greedy damage. Goop turns: block or kill the goop slug. Feed+ the kill for +4 max HP; Bloodletting only if it secures the kill.

summary: Set up Demon Form during the 3 free sleep turns while lightly blocking and keeping her asleep (<=12 damage per hit). After she wakes, use strength-boosted Expect a Fight for block, apply vulnerable, and race before Soul Siphon.
key_turns: T1-3 asleep: Demon Form, then block; hits <=12 absorbed, no wake. T3 Bash+ pre-applies vulnerable. After wake: keep 19-21 block vs Slash/Disembowel 11x2; burst before Soul Siphon.

summary: AOE opener: Thunderclap for mass vuln, Breakthrough hits all, then Feed+ each bug for max HP. Skip Demon Form here; keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: T1 Thunderclap→Breakthrough (17 to all). Kill the ENRAGE bug first; Feed+ executes any bug ≤12 HP. Block after ENRAGE (mandibles ~9); Demon Form only after 2 dead.

summary: Race: apply Bash+ vulnerable, unload attacks, don't turtle. Break the 32 burrow block the turn it appears; block only enough to survive bite 13. Land the killing blow with Feed+ for +4 max HP.
key_turns: Burrow turn (+32 block persists): dump all damage to break it, else eat 23/turn. STUNNED turn is free burst. Kill with Feed+ for +4 max HP.

summary: Race: all damage on the body; Demon Form only on the free turn 1; frontload Bash+/Thunderclap, Feed+ the kill for +4 max HP. Eggs vanish with the body — ignore them.
key_turns: SMASH turns (T2, T5) hit 19-28 — full block, no greedy attacks; Tenderizer/Summon turns unload on body; never attack eggs.

summary: Demon Form turn 1; then Bash+/Dominate for vuln+strength; big single attacks limit Dazes; Expect a Fight blocks BEES/SPEAR once strength is up; Feed+ kill for +4 max HP; save Flex potion for boss.
key_turns: T1 eat BEES 21 to play Demon Form. SPEAR 18 and BEES turns once strength is up: Expect a Fight (30-45 block). PHEROMONE buff turn: unload everything.

summary: Race with AOE: Thunderclap then Breakthrough, finish stragglers with Feed+ for max-HP kills. Never play Demon Form at 20 HP. Block fully on the 19+ incoming turns; Fire potion only if a turn is lethal.
key_turns: Any turn three or four of them attack (~19+) is lethal at 20 HP: full block or kill one first. Focus the 8-damage attackers, then the buffer; Feed+ kills for max HP.

summary: 12 HP — survive: full block on its attack turns, all damage on buff turns; Bash+/Uppercut for vuln then single-hit attacks (thorns costs 5 per hit); skip Demon Form; Fire potion to shorten the kill.
key_turns: Its 23 and 17 attack turns (T2/T3/T5/T6): block fully first. T1/T4/T7 are buff turns: dump attacks. Thorns up: attack only behind 5 block per hit.

summary: Single Sea Punk, 48 HP, attacks 11 then 9 then buffs. Race with Bash+ into attacks, blocking only to shave the 11; save Glowwater for the upcoming elite/boss.
key_turns: Only 48 HP: Bash+ then Twin Strikes ends it in ~3 turns; take the 11 hit on block, avoid extra damage, no potion here.

summary: Race: Breakthrough early (9x3), then focus one slug at a time and kill fast; block every turn. Post-kill turns are spiky (+4 Str survivors). Save Weak Potion unless HP <30; keep 40+ HP for the elite ahead.
key_turns: After any slug death, survivors hit +4 harder (~25/turn): block fully those turns. Double-attack turns (19-20) also demand block; spend HP only for lethal.

summary: Turn 1 is free setup: Inflame, then Bash+ the Calcified Cultist. Race down Calcified first (42 HP, 10-damage hits) with Breakthrough AOE, blocking the ~23/turn combined attacks. Save Weak Potion for the boss.
key_turns: Turn 1: both cultists buff, no damage — Inflame, then Bash+ Calcified. Turns 2-4: combined ~23/turn; block enough, kill Calcified first, Breakthrough for AOE.

summary: Race the eel: Inflame turn 1 while blocking 16, then Bash+ into Twin Strikes/Cinder. Cash the sub-75 stun for max damage, then Weak Potion plus block to survive amplified hits. Keep ~20 HP for boss.
key_turns: Crossing below 75 HP stuns it — free burst turn. After: 99 Vulnerable, hits ×1.5; drink Weak Potion, block hard on CRASH, finish in 2-3 turns.

summary: T1-2 free setup: Inflame+, draw; don't exceed 12 damage on her. T3 unload everything, Bash+ first. Then race: block the 19 and 22 hits, Weak Potion on the big one, before Soul Siphon erodes our Strength/Dexterity.
key_turns: T1-2: damage to her ≤12, no wake. T3: Bash+ first, unload all (wake free). Block 19 and Disembowel 22; Soul Siphon drains Str/Dex — finish before it repeats.

summary: Turn 1: Inflame+ then attack. Race the 92 HP Tunneler: break its 32 burrow block fast to force a stun, keep 67 HP; Glowwater is for the burst turn.
key_turns: Its BURROW turn: spend everything to break the 32 block within 1-2 turns so it gets STUNNED — never turtle through repeated BELOW 23.

summary: Setup fight: Inflame+ then Demon Form on cheap early turns, then AOE (Breakthrough/Stomp) to sweep; kill the 26-HP 8-damage bug first. Stay above ~35 HP for the boss 13 floors away; potions saved.
key_turns: T1-2 incoming only ~11: play Inflame+, block a little, don't trade HP. Once all three attack (~27/turn) sweep with Breakthrough/Stomp or full block. Potions stay unused.

summary: Spend the free summon turn on Demon Form; Inflame+ on turn 2 while blocking the 19 SMASH. Then all damage on Ovicopter — eggs and larvae are ignored, they vanish when it dies. Aim to kill by turn 5.
key_turns: T1 Summon = free: Demon Form. T2 SMASH 19: Inflame+ plus ~11 block. T3 Tenderizer 7: attack hard. Paste/buff turns: full damage. Kill body by T5 before second egg-laying.

summary: T1 is free (4 dmg): play Inflame+, then Inferno (Demon Form only if energy is spare). Then race with Breakthrough/Stomp behind strength; block the 14-18 BITE turns. Focus the Myte that bites next; keep HP >=15.
key_turns: T2 BITE 14 and T3 ~18+ are the danger turns: full block, no greedy race. T1/T4 are light (4-8): play powers/AOE. Kill the bite-next Myte (66hp) first.

summary: T1 Inflame+ with block vs 21; play Demon Form on the free WAR_CHANT turn; fully block FLAIL turns; then strength-boosted Twin Strikes/Breakthroughs finish. A rest site follows, so ~20 HP loss is acceptable.
key_turns: FLAIL 35: all energy into block (Shrug+, Defends, True Grit), no attacks. WAR_CHANT 0 dmg: play Demon Form/Inferno, dump damage. RAM 21: block ~16 plus one attack.

summary: Race Obscura only; the Parasight revives, so damage on it is wasted. Use free turns (T1 summon, T4 Sail) for Demon Form/Inflame+ and burst; block the 9/13 cheaply and kill by T6.
key_turns: T1 free — Demon Form; T2 9-dmg, T3 13-dmg: block cheap. T4 buff turn: burst. From T5 hits grow (16/19/22): kill by T6.

summary: Scale first: Inflame+, Demon Form/Inferno early while blocking; survive the T4 laser; stack strength and use AOE to hold both claws' HP even, then kill both in the same turn — never one early.
key_turns: T3 BUG_STING gives weak2+frail2; T4 LASER 41-49: dump all block (frail shrinks it), never race there. Keep claws within ~20 HP, burst both down one turn.

summary: Single 59 HP worm: turn 1 Unrelenting into free Bash (8 + 2 vulnerable), then race with attacks. Only block on the 11-damage Acid Goop hits; the Inhale buff turn is free damage. Kill in 3-4 turns cheaply.
key_turns: INHALE turn does 0 damage — attack freely, no block. ACID_GOOP 11 turns: cover 11 with block, then attack. Kill by turn 3-4; keep HP near full.

summary: Low-threat slime pack at full HP: play Inferno turn 1 for 6 AOE/turn, drop Unrelenting into free Bash for burst, kill the 11 HP twig slime first, block the 11 poke, finish the medium slime with Strikes.
key_turns: T2 medium slime's POKEY_POUNCE 11 is the only real hit — block it. Inferno + bronze thorns chip 9/turn, so small slimes die by T3 without extra effort.

summary: Turn 1 play Inferno, then Rupture: 6 AOE/turn plus thorns grinds the 45 HP pack. Kill the 2x3 attacker first, block big hits, keep HP for the boss; save the speed potion.
key_turns: T2-3: PIERCING_GAZE 10 alongside Inferno's 6 AOE — block the gaze, kill the 2x3 Inklet first; never let two gazes land unblocked.

summary: Free setup turn: Inferno + Rupture, then focus the Strangler while Inferno AOE clears the slime. Block the LASH turns, end the fight fast because Constrict damage is unblockable, and hold both potions for the elite/boss.
key_turns: Turn 1 is free (status + Constrict): play both powers. Turn 2 brings 11 + 12 + Constrict — block with Defends; from T3 Inferno's 6 AOE finishes the slime.

summary: Turns 1-2 play Inferno then Rupture; thorns punishes its multi-hits. Block the big 18 turns, attack on ROAR/small turns; kill in ~5 turns without extra HP loss.
key_turns: RIP_AND_TEAR 18-damage turns: block fully (Speed Potion if short). ROAR turns: dump attacks. Keep HP >40 for the boss.

summary: Turns 1-2 drop Inferno then Rupture; the 6 AOE/turn plus attacks grinds both Nibbits down in ~4 turns. Block the heavy attack turns, focus the damaged Nibbit, hold both potions for the boss unless HP drops under 40%.
key_turns: Double-BUTT 13+13 turn: full block, no greed. Play Blood Wall after powers online (2 HP loss = +1 Str, 6 AOE). Boss is 3 floors away — HP is the resource.

summary: Turn 1 is free (enemy buffs): drop Rupture + Inferno. Then attack; self-damage fuels 6 AOE + Strength. Block the 22 EXPEL with Blood Wall; save both potions for the boss.
key_turns: T1 free setup. EXPEL ~22 and buffed repeaters are the threats—hold Blood Wall (32 with 臂甲) for them; thorns 3 punishes multi-hits; expect kill by T4-5.

summary: Turns 1-2: Rupture, Inferno (turn 1 is free). Free/stun/Beast-Cry turns: full attacks. Every Plow/Crush/Stomp turn: block fully — first block card doubled by bracer relic. Cure All for the sub-150 burst.
key_turns: Plow 20-24, Crush, Stomp: block fully (Expect a Fight, Blood Wall); save them for these. Ringing turn: one big block card. Free turns (buff/Beast Cry/stun): attack.

summary: Pure race: apply vulnerable with Bash+, burst with Dismantle+/Unrelenting/Fiend Fire, kill before it escapes with stolen cards. Skip powers and potion; block only the 17/21 attacks.
key_turns: Escape Artist 5: it flees ~turn 5 with stolen cards, so kill by turn 3-4. Bash+ first, then Dismantle+/Twin Strike/Unrelenting. Turn 2 FLUTTER is a free attack turn; block the 17 and 21 hits.

summary: Set up Rupture+ then Inferno+ turns 1-2; burst on free BURROW turn; break the 32 persistent block in 1-2 turns using Inferno's 9-damage ticks and multi-hit attacks. Drink Iron only if the 23-loop starts; keep HP for boss.
key_turns: T2 BURROW: free turn, dump attacks/buffs, no block needed. T3+: 32 persistent block + BELOW 23/turn — break the block in 1-2 turns (Inferno ticks, Bash+, multi-hits); never turtle.

summary: Set up Rupture+ then Inferno+ for +2 Strength and 9 AOE per HP loss; Bash+ then Dismantle+/Twin Strike+ carry damage. Block multihit turns with Expect a Fight/Blood Wall; finish with Gigantification-powered Fiend Fire+.
key_turns: WHIRLWIND multihit turns: minimize skills (each adds +6 incoming), block with Expect a Fight/Blood Wall. Gigantification+Fiend Fire+ on the kill turn; keep HP above 20.

summary: Set up Rupture+/Inferno+, block ~24/turn, let Inferno AOE chip all three segments evenly, and only commit attacks/Fiend Fire on the turn all three can die together. Save Expect a Fight for the heaviest attack turns.
key_turns: T1-2 set Rupture+/Inferno+ behind block (~24 incoming). Never kill one segment alone: chip all three via Inferno AOE, then finish all together with Bash+/Molten Fist+ into Fiend Fire+/Dismantle+.

summary: 58 HP hallway bug: Bash then Twin Strike/Sword Boomerang race it down. Block the 11-damage acid turns, take the INHALE turn as free damage, preserve HP for act 1 elite/boss.
key_turns: ACID_GOOP 11: full block (or lethal race if kill is one turn away). INHALE turn: free damage, apply vulnerable. Don't trade HP for speed.

summary: Race the 48 HP Nibbit: Bash then Molten Fist doubles vulnerable for a big hit, block the 12-13 attacks, use the HISS buff turn for free damage, kill within 2-3 turns and keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: Block the 12-13 BUTT hits with Shrug/Defends; treat the HISS (0 damage) turn as free damage; Bash first so Molten Fist doubles the vulnerable stacks for ~15+.

summary: Turn 1 (Summon) is free setup: Bash+ puts 3 vulnerable, Dominate converts that into permanent strength, Molten Fist doubles vulnerable for a big follow-up. Then race down the 78 HP body, blocking the 16-damage Headbutt turns; do not attack…
key_turns: T1 Summon is free: Bash+ then Dominate for permanent strength. Fully block HEADBUTT 16 turns; ignore the illusion add and kill the body.

summary: Race: Bash+ then Molten Fist on Flyconid doubles vuln to 6; Dominate converts it to ~6 strength, Twin Strike burst kills it by T2-T3. Block each turn while mopping up slime; keep weak potion for Vantom.
key_turns: T1 only 11 incoming: play Bash+→Molten Fist→Dominate combo. T2 both attack ~20: finish Flyconid, block the rest. Slime pokes every other turn.

summary: T1 Bash+ (3 vuln). T2 Molten Fist doubles vuln to 6, then Dominate for +7 Strength. T3 Twin Strikes/Sword Boomerangs kill it. Save Weak potion for elite/boss; block only as needed.
key_turns: SWIPE 12 now, then GRASPING_VINES 8, then CHOMP 16. Eat the 12/8 while comboing; kill on T3 with 7 Strength + 7 Vulnerable. If alive T4, block CHOMP fully.

summary: Bird gains strength every turn, so race: T1 Bash+ into Molten Fist doubles vuln while both potions cover the 17 hit; T2 Dominate for ~7 strength, Twin Strike/Sword Boomerang finish by T3.
key_turns: T1 Bash+ then Molten Fist (vuln 6); T2 Dominate nets ~7 strength, then multi-hits. Kill by T3; if it lives past T3 its peck grows — full block, dump everything.

summary: Strip 9 Slippery via multi-hits turns 1-2, then Bash+ into Molten Fist and Dominate (+7 Str) on the free Prepare turn; fully block Dismember turns (T3/T7) and race with buffed multi-hits after.
key_turns: Turns 1-2 strip 9 Slippery with multi-hits; T3/T7 Dismember 27+3 wounds: full block, block potion if HP low; T4 Prepare: Bash+, Molten Fist, Dominate (+7 Str).

summary: Race three 26-29 HP bugs one at a time: T1 Bash+ (3 vuln), T2 Molten Fist doubles vuln to 6 then Dominate for +7 strength, then burst with Twin Strike/Boomerang; full-block the multi-mandible turn, Feed last hits for max HP.
key_turns: T1-2: combo Bash+ then Molten Fist then Dominate on one bug for +7 strength. Then the all-attack turn (~27 raw) needs full block; finish before mandibles ramp.

summary: Race the big rock: Bash+ then Molten Fist for 6 vuln, Dominate for +6 strength, Twin Strikes finish it by turn 2-3. Feed the egg for +3 max HP. Save the energy potion.
key_turns: T1: 22 incoming (15+7) — Bash+ rock, block. Rock's stun turn is the burst window: Molten Fist→Dominate→Twin Strike. Leave the egg ≤16 for a Feed kill (+3 max HP).

summary: Bash+ then Molten Fist gives 6 vuln; Dominate adds +6 strength. Fully block the 23 and 17 hits, never multi-hit while thorns are up, finish with Feed for +3 max HP. Keep the energy potion for the boss kill turn unless it lands lethal here.
key_turns: T2: thorns + 23 spike explosion — Dominate and full block, no attacks. T3: 17 lash, single hits only. T4 buff turn = free damage, Feed kill.

summary: Race: Bash+ then Molten Fist doubles vuln to 6, Dominate gives +6 strength, then Howl/Whirlwind burst on Obscura alone; ignore the reviving Parafright, block its hits, finish by turn 4-5.
key_turns: T1 summon: all damage on Obscura, never on Parafright (revives). T3 chandelier energy: Whirlwind/Howl burst. Kill by ~T4-5 before it buffs too big; block Pierce 13 with Shrug/Uppercut.

summary: Bash+ → Molten Fist (6 vuln) → Dominate (+6 STR); then Twin Strike/Sword Boomerang shred. Drink Regen T1 during setup; block BEES/SPEAR; Feed the kill.
key_turns: T1 BEES 21, T2 SPEAR 18: block 20+, Bash+ into Molten Fist; T3 buff (no attack): Dominate, powers, dump damage. Prefer few large attacks — each adds Dazed. Finish with Feed.

summary: Bash+ then Molten Fist (6 vuln) then Dominate (+6 str) on the 66-HP Myte; kill it before its bite, then out-race the second. Big HP buffer, no potions; land Feed on kills.
key_turns: T2: the TOXIC Myte bites 14 next - kill it first. Then bites alternate every 3 turns; block them. Land Feed kills for +3 max HP.

summary: Hallway race, not a setup fight. Bash+ then Molten Fist (6 vuln) into Dominate (+6 strength), burst Rock while stunned; AOE from Breakthrough/Whirlwind clears Egg and Silk, and the Egg's death fuels Goblin Horn energy plus draw. Block each…
key_turns: Rock headbutts 15 T1 while Silk debuffs — block fully; Rock is stunned next turn, burst it then. Kill the 24-HP Egg early to trigger Goblin Horn (energy+draw).

summary: Setup Bash+ -> Molten Fist (6 vuln) -> Dominate (+6 str) on Crusher while blocking; then race with AOE keeping both claws' HP equal. Flex potion on the final same-turn double kill.
key_turns: T3 BUG_STING 20+weak/frail and T4 LASER 41-49: full block. Keep claw HP aligned; double-kill same turn — beware random Boomerang/Juggernaut killing one early.

summary: Normal fight; race with light block. Pommel Strike kills the twig slime first, then small leaf slime, then medium. Save both potions for elite/boss; keep net HP loss near 10.
key_turns: T2: medium clump shot 8 + twig 4 + small 3 = 15 incoming — block. Kill twig with Pommel Strike first; medium is harmless on its status turns, attack then.

summary: Only 40 HP on the beetle; turn 1 debuff hits for nothing, so frontload damage and finish fast, blocking only the 13 STOMP. Keep both potions for the elite and Vantom boss ahead.
key_turns: T1 Shrinker = 0 damage: dump all attacks. T2-T3 CHOMP 7/STOMP 13: soft-block only, kill by T3-T4.

summary: Turn 1: Inferno + Bash the Jaxfruit; finish it turn 2, then focus Flyconid. Block the vulnerable+SMASH turns, end near 45 HP; save both potions for the boss.
key_turns: Block the SMASH after VULNERABLE_SPORES (~20); frail turns need extra block. Avoid True Grit: random exhaust could eat Whirlwind, needed for Vantom.

summary: Inferno turn 1 gives 12 AOE per turn; then focus one Nibbit down, blocking BUTT turns. Keep HP for the coming elite route; potions only if low.
key_turns: Turn 1-2: buffing Nibbit's BUTT 13+ lands; kill that Nibbit first and block it. Later SLICE 7 turns: block 7, attack freely.

summary: Inferno turn 1 during the beetle's free debuff turn; Inferno+Whirlwind chip both. Focus the 42-HP beetle first, block the ~24 double-attack turns, then finish the wurm before it buffs twice; keep dex potion unless HP drops low.
key_turns: Turn 1 beetle only debuffs — free Inferno setup. Block hard on turns where STOMP 13 and acid ~11 stack (~24); otherwise attack. Inferno pings every turn.

summary: T1 sleep: Inferno plus skill upgrades, no attacks. T2 free: Bash and attack. T3+ block the 23 Slash every turn while dealing steady damage; Dexterity early, Swift only when a hand can't block.
key_turns: T3+ each turn: 23 Slash — keep block up; fear no-block hands. T2 free: Bash and attack; stack attacks in one turn for Slow. No attacks T1.

summary: Turn 1 has no real attack: play Inferno, then Bash+race the 29 HP slime down first, then Strangler. Razor Tooth upgrades cards as played, so block skills get better; save potions for Vantom unless this turns bad.
key_turns: T2: ~23 incoming (11+12) — block hard; T4: ~18. Blood Wall/Shrug It Off after Inferno also triggers 12 AOE; kill slime by T2 to stop its 11-pokes and status cards.

summary: Play Inferno turn 1 (only 7 incoming), strip 9 Slippery with Whirlwind and multi-hits early, then full-block T3/T7 Dismember and go all-out on Prepare turns; keep HP for the run.
key_turns: T2 Inky Lance mild; T3 Dismember 27+3 wounds: full block (Blood Wall/Taunt), never end unblocked; T4 Prepare: dump all damage/powers, no potions. T7 same.

summary: Play Inferno turn 1 for 6 AOE per HP loss (Blood Wall also triggers it), Whirlwind into upgraded attacks, clear all three exoskeletons by turn 3; swift potion saved for Kaiser Crab.
key_turns: T1 low damage (3+8): play Inferno, then Whirlwind; T2-3 finish with AOE before ENRAGE stacks mandibles to ~9 each; block only when total incoming ≥20.

summary: Play Inferno turn 1 behind blocks; turn 2 dump everything into the burrow block to force the stun. Never turtle vs BELOW 23; block only as needed, finish by ~T5, save HP for Kaiser Crab.
key_turns: T2 BURROW: Bash then Hemokinesis and Whirlwind all-in; break the 32 block to trigger the stun. T3+ BELOW 23 each turn — block enough and keep racing, kill by T5.

summary: Inferno turn 1, Inflame early; then Blood Wall plus Hemokinesis convert 2 HP losses into ~39 damage each turn while blocking. Kill before the second Pounce; drink Swift if a turn lacks block.
key_turns: POUNCE (~20) and WEB_CANNON frail turns: hold 16+ block, Colossus halves the hit; finish by ~T5-6 before Inferno self-drain and frail wear us down.

summary: Use the free T1 to play Inferno and Inflame; from T2 block SMASH 19 fully and grind the body with Blood Wall/Hemokinesis triggering Inferno AOE. All damage on the OVICOPTER - its death clears the eggs.
key_turns: T1 Summon is free: Inferno then Inflame. Every SMASH turn (19) full block; Tenderizer 7 turns block and attack. Never target eggs.

summary: Race: Inferno+Inflame T1, Blood Potion T1-2; kill Rock then Silk during the beetle's sleep while blocking headbutts; then block beetle's growing Rolls and grind with vulnerable.
key_turns: T1 rock headbutt 15, and every headbutt turn: full block. T4 beetle wakes (Roll 16, +2 str/turn): block fully, vulnerable then burst. Kill both bugs by T3; never hit sleeping beetle.

summary: HP 14: block first; self-damage (Blood Wall, Hemokinesis, Breakthrough) triggers Inferno 6 AOE. Play Inferno early, Inflame when safe. Keep segments even, finish all three in one turn.
key_turns: T1-T2 block 24; play Inferno then Inflame when safe. Never kill one segment alone—when all ≤25, burst all same turn (Whirlwind/Breakthrough/Hemokinesis/Ampoule). Fear BULK +6 and REATTACH after a sol…

summary: Easy normal fight, 55 total HP. Bash one slug, then Strikes/Headbutt to kill it; repeat on second. Use Shrug It Off/Defends only to blunt GLOMP 10, keep HP near 55+ for the boss path.
key_turns: GOOP turn = free damage; block only the GLOMP 10 swing and 3x2 slaps when cheap. Kill one slug before its big hit lands.

summary: Race the lone seapunk: Bash for vulnerable first, then Strikes/Headbutt. Block every 11/9 attack so HP stays near full for the act boss clock.
key_turns: SEA_KICK 11 and SPINNING_KICK 9 turns: block with Defend/Shrug It Off. BUBBLE_BURP buff turn deals 0 — dump all attacks instead.

summary: Race the rats: Thunderclap for AOE+vulnerability, kill the 18 HP caller first so no reinforcements arrive, block the 14-damage turns, finish in ~3 turns; keep regen potion for the elites ahead.
key_turns: Turn 1: kill the 18 HP rat that calls for backup. Turns with 8+6 attacks: block ~14 with Shrug It Off/Defends; don't drop below ~25 HP.

summary: Race the merc: Bash first for vulnerable, then Strikes/Headbutt every turn, use Shrug It Off/Taunt only on the GIMME turn. Kill by T3–T4 before repeated HEHE strength buffs make it lethal. Save Regen Potion for the elite/boss.
key_turns: T1 eat 8×2 (Bash, then block if needed); T2 HEHE buff (+strength, no damage) — dump all damage; T3 GIMME 16+str — block and finish it before buffs stack.

summary: Play Stone Armor turn 1, vulnerable with Bash/Thunderclap, then race the Cultist down first since it scales; block the double-attack turns and hold both potions for the forced elite next node.
key_turns: T1 only Seapunk hits 11 — play Stone Armor. T2 both attack (~19): full block. Kill Cultist before its strength snowballs; Seapunk cycles 11/9.

summary: Attrition: Stone Armor turn 1 plus blocks, then focus one gardener at a time (lowest/buffing first, biggest hit first to minimize Skittish), fully blocking multi-attack turns. Drink Regen early; Block potion on the worst turn.
key_turns: When 3+ bites/lashes line up (20+ incoming, worse after ENLARGE), spend Blood Wall and Block potion; kill the 27-HP buffing gardener first, one at a time, biggest hit first.

summary: Attrition, not race: Stone Armor + Bash early, hit the 20/turn shell cap each turn, block the 18/15 attack turns, exit with HP for the Waterfall Giant boss; Demise potion turn 1-2.
key_turns: Full block on PIERCING_STABS 18 and ZOOM 15; no-attack INERTIA turn: play power/attacks freely; spread damage to ~20/turn shell cap, avoid overkill waste.

summary: Race the Fossil Stalker: Bash turn 1 for Vulnerable, then Headbutt/Strikes for ~30+/turn, kill in 2-3 turns. Take one 12-14 hit; block only with leftover energy.
key_turns: SUCK_POWER escalates it 3/turn; kill by turn 3. Burst turns 1-2: Bash then Headbutt/Strikes. Block with Shrug It Off/Taunt only with spare energy or low HP.

summary: Free buff turn 1: Stone Armor for 4 plated armor each turn, Bash for vulnerable, then race ~24 dmg/turn (Headbutt/Stomp/Bash) to kill before Pressure Gun scales, fully blocking each attack turn and the 36-45 explosion.
key_turns: T5 Pressure Gun 20+, T10 25+: full block, no racing. After the kill, ABOUT_TO_BLOW turn: build 40+ block (Blood Wall/Evil Eye/Defends) for the explosion.

summary: Race: focus one slug, use Stomp while both alive, Bash then Twin Strike. Block only on the double-attack turn. Keep Strength potion and Impervious for the elite/boss.
key_turns: GOOP turn (0 damage) is free attacks; block fully the turn both attacks land; kill slug #1 by turn 2-3; hold Impervious for the boss explosion.

summary: Race the 49 HP Seapunk: Bash for vulnerable, block the 11/9 kicks efficiently, burst on its no-attack buff turn. Save Strength Potion and Impervious for the boss or an elite.
key_turns: SEA_KICK 11 now, then SPINNING_KICK 9: block with Defends/Shrug only. BUBBLE_BURP buff turn = free damage dump with vulnerable up; kill by turn 4.

summary: Race the 51 HP Gremlin Merc: Bash for vulnerable, then all attacks while blocking the 13/16 hits with Shrug It Off and Defends. Keep Impervious and both potions for the Waterfall Giant boss.
key_turns: GIMME (8×2=16) steals 20 gold — block it fully; HEHE buff turn is the free attack turn; finish by turn 3; do not spend Impervious.

summary: Race the 82 HP fog: Bash early for vulnerable, then Twin/Pommel/Spite and Strikes; block its 8s with Defend/Shrug. Rupture is dead here, so skip it. Save Fortifier for the boss explosion, Strength for a kill turn.
key_turns: Biggest hit is SUPER_GAS_BLAST 8 (follows BLOAT 5); ADVANCED_GAS 8 also adds a status card, so block 8 each turn and don't let hand clog delay the kill.

summary: Three rats, 61 total HP, 14 incoming now. Race them: Bash for vulnerable, Twin/Pommel/Spite on one target, Stomp to sweep when several are low. Take a little chip damage if needed; save Impervious, Fortifier and Strength potion for the Wat…
key_turns: Kill the Attack-8 rat first, then the Screech caster; Bash+Stomp when 2+ rats remain. Expect a Screech debuff and disease/curse cards — keep drawing with Shrug/Pommel. No Impervious or potions here.

summary: Race, no setup powers (Rupture gains nothing without self-damage). T1 free — attack hard, Bash for vulnerable. Focus Calcified (39 HP, hits 10); block ~23/turn combined. Save both potions for the boss.
key_turns: T1 both buff: free turn, full offense with Bash for vulnerable. T2+ both strike ~23 combined; block the big turns, keep racing Calcified; if their damage ramps, race harder.

summary: No real scaling (Rupture is dead), so race: Bash+ early to extend Vulnerable, throw all damage, kill ~T8-T10 to cap explosion stacks. Fully block guns; save Impervious+Fortifier for the explosion turn.
key_turns: T5 gun 20 and T10 gun 25: block fully. Kill by ~T9-10. Use the free ABOUT_TO_BLOW turn to stack block; Impervious+Fortifier against the 36+ explosion.

summary: Powers first (Crimson Mantle feeds Rupture +1 Str/turn and always doubles Spite), then race: Bash+ and Stomp, killing the lowest-HP bug first; block on turns when all three mandible.
key_turns: T1-2 low incoming: play Crimson Mantle/Rupture. From T3 all three may mandible ~9 each (~27): block or Stomp-kill. Finish each bug with one big hit — Hard to Kill.

summary: Crimson Mantle then Rupture: 7 block and +1 Strength every turn, and Spite always double-hits for 0 energy (it triggers off Crimson Mantle's HP loss). Multi-hit attacks strip Plating, Bash+ amplifies, block hard on FLAIL 35, race it down.
key_turns: WAR_CHANT turn deals 0: play powers and dump damage. Next FLAIL 35: play Impervious and full block, no greedy attacks. Strip the 6 Plating with Spite/Twin Strike before Bash+.

summary: Crimson Mantle first; Ruptures on the free Burrow turn. At 35 HP hold ~20 block vs BELOW 23, break the 32 block within two turns, kill with Spite/Dismantle. Dex potion covers a bad turn, Swift for lethal.
key_turns: T2 Burrow is free: play Ruptures, unload before 32 block lands. T3+ BELOW 23: block ~20 with Mantle plus Shrug/Taunt; break the 32 block in two turns — don't turtle.

summary: Scale Crimson Mantle + double Rupture while blocking 17-21 a turn; each goop turn play minimal cards; kill the 126 HP Hunter Killer in ~5 turns and stay above 35 HP for the boss.
key_turns: Goop turn: one attack, one power, nothing else. Full-block Puncture 21; cap Bite 17 loss. Dex potion on a 21 turn holding block; Swift only at low HP.

summary: Play Inferno, both Ruptures and Crimson Mantle in the first two turns while blocking the 16 Clamp; Inferno ticks plus growing strength kill both Chompers by turn 5-6, preserving HP for the boss.
key_turns: Every turn brings Clamp 16 — always block it; SCREECH turns clog statuses and the riskiest is a drawn hand without block. After powers, AOE ticks and strength carry the kill.

summary: Engine first, then race. Ruptures+Mantle+Inferno: +4 strength, 12 auto-damage, 7 block per turn; Spite hits twice. Block the 29s, extend sandpit only at ≤2, spend Swift to close the kill; keep HP for Act 3.
key_turns: T1 (no attack): Rupture x2, Mantle; T2 Inferno. T3 bite 29: max block, Dex potion if short. Sandpit ≤2: Frantic Escape first unless lethal. Hold Swift for kill turn.

summary: Race the 48 HP Nibbit: play Inflame turn 1 while still blocking the 12 with Shrug It Off + Defend, then Bash and Strikes to finish by T3-4; save Dexterity Potion for the Kin boss.
key_turns: T1 BUTT 12: Inflame plus Shrug It Off/Defend for full block. T2 SLICE 7: Bash then Strike. T3 HISS (0 dmg): dump every attack; kill before T4 BUTT.

summary: Treat T1 as free setup: Inflame, then Bash/Thunderclap plus Peck to burst the beetle and stop Shrink. Block Stomp 13 with Shrug It Off, stay near full HP, and save the dexterity potion for the Kin boss's Beam turn.
key_turns: T1 Shrinker debuff (no damage): play Inflame, then attack freely. Block the 13 Stomp turns; burst the beetle before its next Shrink so damage stays intact for the Kin boss.

summary: Race Byrdonis: Inflame turn 1, Bash+ for vulnerable, block each 17-20 hit with Shrug/Blood Wall while attacking; both potions turn 1; kill by turn 5 before strength stacks.
key_turns: T1 Inflame plus full block; each turn after is 18-22 and rising, never skip block; T3-T5 are the feared hits, finish by then.

summary: Turn 1 Inflame (free +2 strength), then Bash+ for vulnerable and dump Twin Strike/Peck/Strikes. Block the 16-damage Chomp turn fully; Blood Wall only if it prevents real HP loss. Preserve HP for boss.
key_turns: Chomp 16 turn: full block via Shrug It Off/Defends or Blood Wall, skip risky chip damage. Grasping Vines 8 turn: take it while attacking. Kill by ~turn 5.

summary: Turn 1 Inflame, then AOE (Breakthrough/Thunderclap) plus Bash+ to kill the 28 HP slime, applying vulnerable to both. Then focus Flyconid, fully blocking its 13 Smash and never letting frail catch us unblocked. Keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: T2 is 11+13=24 with frail (-25% block) — pre-block with Taunt/Shrug/Blood Wall. Flyconid's Vulnerable Spores turn does no damage: kill slime by then, then burn Flyconid before its next Smash.

summary: 26 HP hallway fight: Inflame on the free first turn, then every attack turn block 18–22 before attacking; drop the 70 HP cube by turn 4–5, then heal 6 after.
key_turns: T1 is free (0 incoming): Inflame + strip Artifact via Thunderclap/Taunt before Bash+ vuln. Then expect 18–22 per turn; block fully (Blood Wall+Defend), kill by T4–5.

summary: Use the status-card turn to play Inflame and AOE down both small slimes, then focus the 29 HP twig medium so only one attacker remains. Block the 19-26 damage turns and preserve HP for the rest site and Kin boss.
key_turns: T1 nearly free (4 dmg): Inflame, then Breakthrough+Thunderclap kills both small slimes. After that mediums hit 11+8 (plus Slimed clog): block those turns, keep HP for the Kin boss.

summary: Inflame turn 1; Thunderclap/Breakthrough the followers, killing the left buffer first; then Bash+/Dismantle the 199-HP priest with Vulnerable while banking full block on Beam turns. Use Clarity early; never trade HP for damage.
key_turns: T3/T7/T11 BEAM (grows with Ritual strength): full block, no greedy attacks. Kill left follower first; AOE both with Vulnerable. Watch combined follower damage ~12-20/turn.

summary: Two 24–25 HP Toadpoles: race them. Kill the buffer/spiked one first, use Bash+Molten Fist for doubled vulnerable, Stomp when both are alive; keep HP above ~16 and end the fight fast with Burning Blood healing back.
key_turns: Turns where both pokes attack (7+9=16+ at A8): block or kill one. SPIKE_SPIT/WHIRL hit 7–9; if a Toadpole has spikes up, avoid many small hits, land one big attack. Bash→Molten Fist doubling.

summary: Race this single 60 HP construct: strip Artifact, land Vulnerable, double it with Molten Fist, Stomp after two attacks. Block the 14-damage punch turns fully, avoid chip damage, stay 30+ HP for the coming elite/boss path.
key_turns: Artifact absorbs the first debuff: play Thunderclap/Bash first, then Molten Fist to double Vulnerable. Fully block the STRONG_PUNCH 14 turns (Defend+Shrug); unload all damage on 0-damage READY turns.

summary: Race with Bash then Molten Fist (double Vulnerable) plus Strikes; cross 75 HP to stun its CRASH away. After the 99 Vulnerable, block fully with Uppercut Weak; Swift Potion on the biggest attack turn.
key_turns: Its CRASH turns (~23, x1.5 once shrieked) are the danger: full block plus Uppercut Weak there. Trigger the 75-HP stun early to cancel one attack.

summary: Solo 55 HP stalker hitting 12/14/12. Race it: Bash into Molten Fist for 4 Vulnerable, then Uppercut/Hemokinesis finish. Block each hit enough to preserve HP for Soul Fysh; potions only if the race goes long.
key_turns: LATCH (14) is the big hit — block fully. Stack Vulnerable with Bash then Molten Fist on turns 1-2; kill by turn 3. Never eat an unblocked hit below ~20 HP.

summary: Race but stay healthy: block every turn, chain Thunderclap/Bash into doubled-vulnerable Molten Fist on the Cultist, kill it first then Seapunk. Attack Potion on the killing turn, Swift early for block/damage, enter Soul Fysh near full HP.
key_turns: T1 Cultist only buffs: block Seapunk's 11, then Bash the Cultist. From T2 both attack ~21/turn: full block every turn; kill Cultist first to stop its scaling.

summary: Block the 21 De Gas, exhaust Beckons with Burning Pact/True Grit, keep Vulnerable doubled via Bash then Molten Fist, burst with Attack Potion on a non-Intangible turn; never attack into Intangible. Enter at 65 HP.
key_turns: Turn 2 DE_GAS ~21 and SCREAM 13: full block. FADE/Intangible turns: no attacks, dump Beckons, block. Burst with Attack Potion on a non-Intangible turn after doubled Vulnerable.

summary: Race: Thunderclap/Bash for vulnerable then Hemokinesis/Molten Fist on one bug at a time; block the ~27-damage mandible turns; no Juggernaut setup; Distilled Chaos only to close the kill.
key_turns: Post-enrage mandibles ~9 each (~27/turn): full block those turns. Focus lowest-HP bug; finish Hard-to-Kill survivors with Stomp/Thunderclap AOE. Keep HP>40 for boss.

summary: Rupture + Hemokinesis early, then race: strip the 32 burrow block the moment it appears, block each 23 BELOW, kill by turn 4-5, keeping HP >30 for the coming boss.
key_turns: BURROW: no attack, +32 persistent block — dump all attacks into stripping it, don't idle-defend. Each BELOW turn deals 23: block it, apply Weak via Uppercut, race the kill.

summary: Race the 126 HP body; never hit eggs. Rupture + Hemokinesis grows strength, Juggernaut chips on every block. Fully block each SMASH 19 (~T2 onward). Save Gambler's Brew to fix a lethal-risk hand; Distilled Chaos for the kill burst.
key_turns: T1 Summon is free: play Rupture + Juggernaut. Fully block SMASH 19 turns (~T2, recurring), no greedy attacks there. LAY_EGGS/buff turns: dump all damage on Ovicopter.

summary: Ignore the Parafright entirely. Play Rupture (Hemokinesis triggers strength) and Feel No Pain, then dump every attack into the Obscura and block its growing swings; kill within ~5 turns at 42 HP.
key_turns: T1 summon turn: all damage on Obscura. Escalating 16→19→22→25 strikes from T3; hold True Grit/Shrug block for those, never hit the Parafright.

summary: Short race: Bash for vulnerable, then Twin Strike/Strikes. Block the 12-damage BUTT, use the HISS buff turn for free damage, kill in ~3 turns. Speed Potion saved for the Act 1 boss.
key_turns: T1 BUTT 12: block fully with Defends. T2 SLICE 7: cheap block, push damage. T3 HISS (no attack, self-buff): dump everything — expect BUTT to hit harder after.

summary: Short hallway fight: Bash for vulnerable then Strikes/Twin Strike to race 58 HP down in about three turns, blocking the 11-damage Acid Goop turns; save both potions for the forced elite ahead.
key_turns: ACID_GOOP turns (11 dmg) — block fully, avoid chip damage; the INHALE buff turn is free, dump all damage; expect a kill in 3-4 turns.

summary: Race the 66 HP parasite (block its 16 LASH), saving Howl from Beyond to clear the four wrigglers. Then focus one wriggler at a time, using Speed/Block potions on the worst incoming turns; wrigglers gain 2 Strength every other turn.
key_turns: Parasite: block LASH 16, race on INFECT turns. After split, hold no punches: Howl on wrigglers once ~18 kills; focus one wriggler at a time; potions when incoming ≥30.

summary: Four stunned wrigglers: free turn. Play Howl from Beyond (18 to all), then kill wounded ones one at a time with Strikes/Twin Strike before bites ramp. Hold Block Potion for the first multi-bite wave.
key_turns: T1 all four stunned: dump max damage, Howl hits all for 18. Kill wounded wrigglers one by one. Danger: first multi-bite wave (8 each, +2 str every 2 turns) — Block Potion if HP low.

summary: Race the hallway: Howl from Beyond turn 1 (18 to both), Bash then Twin Strike/Strikes into Flyconid, fully block SMASH turns. Both Strength potions stay saved for Vantom's 183 HP.
key_turns: Flyconid's SMASH 13 after frail/vulnerable spores: full block those turns (frail weakens Defends). Kill Flyconid by turn 3-4; Howl turn 1 for 18 to both.

summary: Race Fogmog: no powers in deck, so apply Bash+ vulnerable then Twin/Perfected Strike. Ignore the summoned add, block big hits with Shrug/True Grit, keep both Strength potions for Vantom.
key_turns: Turn 1 is a free summon turn: Bash+ then attack. Block the 16 HEADBUTT turns; after SWIPE buffs it, hits grow — kill Fogmog by turn 4-5.

summary: Race both enemies down: turn-1 Howl plus Popper/Hourglass chip clears the Slime and mauls Flyconid, then Bash+ and finish fast. Save both Strength potions for Vantom; enter the rest site with HP intact.
key_turns: T1: Howl = 36 AoE with auto-replay, likely kills Slime; T2 block ~24 (SMASH 13 + poke 11) if Flyconid lives; finish it before spores stack frail/vuln.

summary: No powers in deck: race behind block. Strip Slippery 9 with Twin Strike/Sword Boomerang, Bash+ vulnerable, full-block Dismember turns, dump everything plus both Strength potions on Prepare turns; kill by second cycle.
key_turns: T3/T7 Dismember (26-30 + 3 wounds): full block. T4/T8 Prepare: burst with Strength potions and Bash+ vulnerable. T1-2 strip 9 Slippery with multi-hits.

summary: Race: Offering for tempo, Bash+ vulnerable, then Howl from Beyond (hits twice, 36 AoE). Kill the nectar bug first; stone self-stuns. Finish on free turn 2, block leftovers turn 3.
key_turns: T1: Bash+ then Howl (18 now, 18 at end of turn). T2 is free (stone stunned, nectar buffs) — finish a bug. T3: block 15/18 if anything lives.

summary: Race with AOE: Inflame then Howl from Beyond clears all three; multihit strips Hard to Kill, focus lowest HP, block Mandible turns. End in ~4 turns, keep HP for the boss path.
key_turns: T1 is safe (11 in): Inflame/Offering, then Howl while all three live; Bash+ then Bully the focus. Block fully when 2+ Mandibles land (~9-12 each).

summary: Race the Entomancer with big single hits to limit Dazed; Inflame early, block only BEES/Spear, dump damage on buff turn; drink Flex T1 per prior deaths; kill by turn 6, then keep HP for the act boss.
key_turns: T1 BEES: drink Flex, Offering+, Inflame. Block BEES/Spear turns (Taunt/True Grit); PHEROMONE buff turn: all-out damage. Speed potion if a Dazed-clogged turn would cost 20+. Kill by turn 6.

summary: Kill Silk first to stop unblockable poison; Inflame early, then Bash+ into Howl on Rock's stunned turn. Block the headbutts and let relic chip damage finish the egg.
key_turns: T1/T3 block Rock's 15 headbutt; T2 Rock is stunned, so Bash+ then Howl burst on Silk. Kill Silk before its second toxic spit lands.

summary: Four 26-30 HP bugs with Hard-to-Kill: race with Howl from Beyond for double 18 AOE, Inflame if a turn is safe, multi-hits (Twin Strike/Boomerang/Pommel) on the lowest-HP bug, and block hard on mass-attack turns; relics chip survivors.
key_turns: Any turn all four show attack intents (up to ~30 combined): full block via Shrug/Evil Eye/True Grit. T1-2 play Howl (18 AOE, replays exhausted = 36). Late stragglers die to hourglass/cuddle chip.

summary: Full HP, hard clock: turn 1 Inflame, Bash+ for vulnerable, then race with Twin Strike/Sword Boomerang/Pommel Strike; block the 29 bite; play Frantic Escape whenever sandpit ≤2 to stay alive.
key_turns: Lunging Bite (~29): full block, no greedy damage. Sandpit ≤2: play Frantic Escape first every turn to reset the kill clock. Turns 1-2: Inflame, then Bash+ for vulnerable before bursting.

summary: Single easy target: race it down. Open Bash+ into Molten Fist for 6 vuln, dump Strikes/Headbutt, play Inflame only if it costs no kill turn. Drink attack potion on the finishing turn to skip an 8-12 hit.
key_turns: T1 Oil Spray 8 + weak cuts our damage 25%; T2 Slam 12. Bash+ then Molten Fist doubles vuln to 6; block only to cap hits, kill by turn 3-4.

summary: Race both toadpoles: Inflame turn 1, Setup Strike into Bash+ and Molten Fist (vuln doubled) to kill the 22 HP one first, then the 26. Block only the double-attack turn; stay above 40 HP.
key_turns: No spike turn yet; the double SPIKE_SPIT (18) is the worst — block that one. Kill before the cycle reaches WHIRL. Single big hits beat multi-hit if SPIKEN grants thorns.

summary: Race the 67 HP ship: free turn 1 for Inflame, then Bash+ into Molten Fist for 6 vulnerable; block only the 12-13 hits needed to keep HP above ~30, using potions to force the kill by turn 5.
key_turns: T1 HAUNT deals nothing: Inflame + attacks. SWIPE 13/STOMP 12 turns: block to stay safe; race once lethal is within 2 turns; finish ~T5 before 5 status cards clog.

summary: Race three slugs: Inflame T1, Bash+ then Molten Fist (vuln 6) to delete the lowest-HP slug, then Setup Strike/Sword Boomerang and clean up; keep incoming under 5/turn; save potions for the boss.
key_turns: Block fully on the turn combining GLOMP 10 + 8 (~19) and after GOOP's WHIP_SLAP 9. Kill one slug at a time; don't spread damage or Ravenous healing outpaces it.

summary: Normal fight at healthy HP: play Inflame (then Crimson Mantle) early, apply Bash+ so Molten Fist doubles vuln, block the 12-14 hits, kill fast. Hold both potions for the elite/boss ahead.
key_turns: Watch LATCH 14 and any scaling from SUCK_POWER 3; Bash+ first, then Molten Fist doubles vuln to 6; block every attack turn; kill by ~turn 4.

summary: 首回合无攻击：先燃烧+绯红披风建成长，之后每回合约 25 伤推进，痛击+易伤后熔融之拳翻倍。全程挡压力枪，HP 高于蒸汽层数，T9-10 击杀并留格挡吃自爆。
key_turns: T5/T10 压力枪 20/25 全挡；ABOUT_TO_BLOW 回合用战斗专注/头槌找并顶格挡牌；自爆回合癫狂之触免费『跃跃欲试』+血墙挡 36-45；T9-10 前击杀。

summary: Play powers turn 1 behind enough block for 18 incoming, then kill Bowlbug Rock (15 headbutt, then self-stun), burst it on the stun turn, and kill Nectar before its 18-damage thrash. Exit near 50+ HP; keep the attack potion for Knowledge De…
key_turns: T1 block the 15+3 while playing Inflame+; T2 Rock is stunned after its headbutt — free burst to kill it; from T3 Nectar thrashes 18/turn, hold ~18 block and finish it.

summary: Five-turn race: Inflame+ and block powers up front, block the 17/21 hits, apply Bash+ vulnerable then Molten Fist and multi-hits for ~25/turn, killing it before it steals a card and flees.
