key_turns: Block the HAT_TRICK 21 and THIEVERY 17 turns fully (Shrug It Off+); Inflame+ then Bash+ → Molten Fist/Sword Boomerang burst to kill before the 5-turn escape.

summary: Race a 140 HP Louse Progenitor from 37 HP: Inflame+/Unmovable+ turn 1, block every Pounce, spend the attack potion in the first two turns to cut a whole turn, kill before the second Pounce.
key_turns: CURL_AND_GROW turns: dump attacks. WEB_CANNON 12(+脆弱): block, then hit. POUNCE 20-24 twice: full block, never eat it at 37 HP.

summary: Free turn 1: stack strength and passive block. From turn 2 race the 129 HP Obscura, all damage on it, never the Parafright (it revives). Drink the Strength potion turn 1-2, block the scaling 16-25 hits, win by turn 5.
key_turns: T1 Summon is free: play Inflame+, Unmovable+, Crimson Mantle. Then block 12-25 smash/gaze turns; never hit the reviving Parafright; race Obscura down by turn 4-5.

summary: Race both Toadpoles: T1 Bash+Twin Strike exactly kills the 7-damage attacker (take 0); T2 kill the Spiken caster with Bash+2 Strikes. Skip Inflame, save Binding potion for elite/boss; Burning Blood recovers chip damage.
key_turns: T1 Bash+Twin Strike kills the 22-HP 7-damage attacker exactly, take 0. T2 (4 energy via Candlestick) Bash+2 Strikes kills the Spiken caster; accept small Spikes chip, don't over-hit it.

summary: One 47 HP Seapunk, cycles 11/9/buff. Play Inflame turn 1, Bash for vulnerable, then race with Twin Strike/Pommel Strike; kill by the buff turn. Hold Binding potion for elite/boss.
key_turns: T1 SEA_KICK 11: play Inflame then block/take it; T2 SPINNING_KICK 9; T3 BUBBLE_BURP hits 0 — dump everything and kill.

summary: Turn 1 play Inflame (permanent strength); Bash the weakest gardener, use Binding potion early for weak+vulnerable on all four plus trinket strength. Then focus-fire one gardener down at a time to cut incoming damage; block hard on ENLARGE-…
key_turns: Kill the 27 HP gardener first, then one per turn or two; lead each turn's attacks on the target with your biggest hit (Skittish blocks only after the first). Once ENLARGE makes 3-4 attacks land for 1…

summary: Turn 1 Inflame, then Bash for vulnerable and race it down in ~4 turns. Fully block the two 16-damage turns; keep Energy Potion for the boss.
key_turns: GIMME (16) and DOUBLE_SMASH (8×2) turns: full block with Taunt/Shrug; HEHE buff turn: dump Bash + attacks freely.

summary: Turn 1 Inflame plus full block on the 11 hit. Race down the Calcified Cultist first (Bash for vulnerable, then Twin Strike/Whirlwind), keep Shrug It Off for the combined-attack turn, and preserve HP for the forced elite next node.
key_turns: Cultist buffs now, then its Dark Strike grows each turn (10→13+): kill it by turn 3. Block Seapunk's 11 on turn 1; fear the turn both attack (~22 combined).

summary: Play Inflame turn 1, then Bash and Molten Fist (doubled vulnerable) to frontload: cross the 75 HP Shriek line for a free stun turn. Block every CRASH fully; after Shriek, never trade HP.
key_turns: Fear CRASH 23 (turn 1 and after THRASH): full block with Shrug/Taunt, Speed Potion only if block in hand. Race it under 75 HP to trigger the Shriek stun, then nurse the 99 vulnerable through guarded …

summary: At 30 HP play Inflame turn 1, then Bash into Molten Fist to double vulnerable and burst the 82 HP fog in ~4 turns, blocking the 8-damage gas turns to keep HP for the coming elite/shop node.
key_turns: Gas turns (8 + card debuff) and SUPER_GAS_BLAST 8: cover with Shrug It Off/Taunt; BLOAT turns are free to attack with Bash/Twin Strike/etc.

summary: Inflame turn 1. Fully block the 21/13 turns; on FADE turns play Beckons and skills, never attack. Bash then Molten Fist doubles vulnerable; burst with Dismantle/Twin Strike/Whirlwind. Kill it before Beckons pile up.
key_turns: T2 DE_GAS 21: block fully (candle grants +1 energy). T4 FADE intangible: no attacks, dump Beckons, block. T5 SCREAM 13 block. Spend spare energy on Beckons; don't over-draw into them.

summary: 47 HP normal fight at full HP: stack Bash+/Uppercut vulnerable then Dismantle twice-dips, block only the 12-13 BUTT hits, finish before the second butting. No potions needed.
key_turns: Now: BUTT 12-13 — Shrug It Off/Defend first, then Bash+ into Dismantle for double 8. HISS buff turn is free full offense; SLICE 7 is chip.

summary: Full-HP hallway; race Flyconid with vulnerable burst: Bash+ then Molten Fist (vuln→6) and Dismantle for 16. Spend Shrug It Off on the Smash 13; save Power Potion for the Kin boss.
key_turns: Kill Flyconid by T2–T3: Bash+, then Molten Fist doubles vuln, Dismantle hits twice. Shrug It Off for the 11/13 hits; once Flyconid dies, Jaxfruit (3/buff) is trivial.

summary: Three raiders, 76 total HP: race with vulnerability, kill the 10/turn Assassin first, then Brute before its ROAR buff. Stomp while 2+ alive. Block the T3 swings, keep ~60 HP for boss; Power Potion stays for boss T1.
key_turns: T1 22 incoming (5+7+10): Bash+ then Dismantle+ kills Assassin. Brute ROAR next turn is free damage; Axe BIG_SWING 12 and Brute BEAT 8 come T3 — block then.

summary: Race: Bash+ into Dismantle+/Molten Fist, kill Strangler by turn 2-3, then clean the 34 HP slime; save Power Potion for the Kin boss.
key_turns: T2: LASH 12 + Slime 8 = 20 incoming — kill Strangler first or block ~20. Constriction chips every turn; Molten Fist first makes Evil Eye 16 block.

summary: Race the Mawler: Bash+ then Molten Fist (vuln to 6) then Dismantle+ for ~30 burst, still blocking the 18 hit. Hold Power Potion for Kin boss turn 1; rest before boss.
key_turns: Block the 18-damage Rip and Tear fully; unload attacks on Roar (0 dmg) turns. Kill by turn 5-6 before its buffs stack.

summary: Race: Bash+ then Dismantle+ burst the Flyconid by turn 2 (it stacks Frail/Vulnerable, hits 13), then finish the slime. Hold Power Potion for the boss; Fortifier only if HP drops low.
key_turns: T2 Flyconid SMASH 13 while Frail weakens your block; T4 SMASH again. Block those turns; slime's 0-damage status turns are free attacks.

summary: Drink Power Potion turn 1 for a permanent power (Inflame/Demon Form ideal), then Bash+ and Molten Fist to extend vulnerability, Stomp both followers before they grow, then grind the priest; Fortifier saved for the 21-damage Beam turns.
key_turns: T3/T7/T11 Beam 21 + both followers: full block, Fortifier here. Ritual buffs mean the fight only gets worse — Stomp both followers down by ~T6.

summary: Hallway swarm: AOE (Conflagration, Stomp) plus Bash+ into Dismantle+/Molten Fist burst one bug at a time. Damage-per-hit cap wastes big singles, so favor multi-hit. Keep HP for the boss; no potions banked.
key_turns: T1-2: Conflagration + Stomp for AOE; Hard to Kill caps each hit at 9, so multi-hit and AOE beat big singles. Block from T3 when enraged mandibles hit 9-12 each.

summary: Full HP. Frontload: Bash+ then Molten Fist (vuln to 6) then Dismantle+ double hit. Break BURROW's 32 block within two turns and race it down by T4-5; block only the 13 bites.
key_turns: T1 BITE 13: partial block, start vuln chain. T2 BURROW (no attack): dump all damage to break 32 block fast; never turtle — afterwards it's 23/turn until dead.

summary: AOE race: Conflagration and cheap Stomp to clear the swarm, Bash+ into Molten Fist/Dismantle+ for vuln burst one target at a time, block heavy turns, keep HP for the run.
key_turns: Any turn 3-4 bugs attack (~25-30 dmg): full block via Shrug it Off+/Flame Barrier. Play Stomp after 3 attacks (cost 0). Kill the 29 HP ENRAGE buffer first.

summary: Focus one Chomper: Uppercut strips its 2 Artifacts, then Bash+ lands vuln; block ~16 on Clamp turns, dump damage on SCREECH turns; Conflagration/Stomp soften both. Power Potion stays for the boss.
key_turns: Clamp turns (~16 incoming): block first. SCREECH turns (no attack): full damage. Strip Artifact 2 with Uppercut/Taunt before Bash+ vuln. If both clamp (~32), wall up.

summary: Full HP attack race, minimal skills. Bash+ then Molten Fist (vuln 6) then Dismantle+ ≈50 on turn 1; accept ~25-35 damage. Save both potions for the Insatiable boss — deck has no Strength source.
key_turns: RADIATE/WHIRLWIND turns: at most 1 skill (Vital Spark grants +2 per hit) — one Flame Barrier or Defend+; PULSATE buff turn: no block, full attack.

summary: T1 goop deals nothing: drink power potion, play Bash+ then Molten Fist+ to stack vulnerability, then multihits. On Puncture/Bite turns block first with Defends/Shrug, then attack. Race it down in 4-5 turns; keep vuln potion for the boss un…
key_turns: T1 GOOP: no damage, free setup/damage. Every later turn PUNCTURE 21 or BITE 17: play block cards first (dex drops per card), then attack; keep ~21 block ready.

summary: Race the sandpit clock; no powers to set up. T1-T2 stack vulnerable (Bash+, vuln potion, Molten Fist+ doubles it) then each turn dump Dismantle+/Squash/Conflagration. Block the 29 bite with Shrug/Flame Barrier; take every affordable Franti…
key_turns: T1 is a no-attack buff turn: Bash+ then vuln potion then Molten Fist+ to double vuln to ~12. Block LUNGING_BITE 29 fully. Once sandpit hits 2, play every affordable Frantic Escape.

summary: Drop Stone Armor early, then race: kill the buffing toadpole first (its buff turn is free damage), then the 23-HP attacker. Block both-attack turns. Save both potions for the upcoming elite/boss; Waterfall Giant needs HP.
key_turns: T1 only 7 incoming: play Stone Armor. Both-attack rounds (~9+7) are the only threat; block those. Kill the buffing toadpole before Spiken stacks; single hits if it gains Spikes.

summary: Focus one slug at a time (lowest HP first): play Stone Armor turn 1, use Setup Strike on multi-hit burst turns, then race. Block the ~19-damage turns, drink Weak early, Blood potion only if HP drops dangerously.
key_turns: T2-T3 all slugs attacking (~19 incoming): full block while still killing one; block GLOMP-10 turns; don't spread damage across slugs.

summary: Both cultists buff turn 1, so set up Plating for free, then race: kill Calcified (39 HP) first with Bash + Twin Strike, then Damp. Block the 17-25 combined strikes; heal potion only if dying.
key_turns: Turn 1 both cultists only buff - free Stone Armor + Bash on Calcified. Turns 2-5 combined strikes 17-25, block fully; weak potion if incoming >=20. After Calcified dies, Damp alone hits 10-15.

summary: Turn 1 Stone Armor for free plating, then frontload damage to cross half HP and steal the stun turn. After the 99 Vulnerable, stop trading HP — full-block CRASH/THRASH turns and finish with Setup Strike plus multi-hit attacks.
key_turns: Free turn when it drops below 75 HP (stun cancels its attack) — push damage to trigger it. Afterwards 99 Vulnerable makes every hit ~1.5x: block CRASH turns fully, weak potion on the biggest one.

summary: Play Stone Armor turn 1 for free plating, Bash for vulnerability, then race: Twin Strike/Pommel/Bully the 54 HP Stalker down by turn 3-4. Drink nothing; keep droplet and blood potion for the Waterfall Giant boss.
key_turns: No burst turn: it hits 12/14 every turn. Stone Armor T1 (4 block/turn), Bash for vulnerability, block the LATCH 14, kill by T4 before Suck stacks.

summary: Play Stone Armor turn 1, then race down the Ritual cultist while blocking Sea Kicks; no potions here — save heal and draw potions for the Waterfall Giant boss in 3 floors.
key_turns: Cultist buffs T1: play Stone Armor, then attack freely. Kill Cultist first to stop Ritual scaling; block Seapunk's 11/9 kicks with Defends, Blood Wall on double-attack turns.

summary: Play Stone Armor turn 1, then Bash for vulnerability and race the merc down in ~4 turns while blocking most of each 13-16 hit. Save both potions for the Waterfall Giant boss unless HP drops below ~18.
key_turns: No free turns: it attacks every turn for 16/16/13 and steals 20 gold per hit. Keep ~12+ block each turn, land Bash vulnerability early, kill by turn 4; rest site is next.

summary: Play Stone Armor and Crimson Mantle on the no-attack opening, then race ~25 damage per turn while fully blocking Pressure Gun; kill by T10 with HP above the steam count, then full-block the 36-45 self-destruct.
key_turns: T1 free buff turn: both powers. Block Pressure Gun (T5 20, T10 25); burst on Siphon. After the kill, full-block the 36-45 explosion with HP above steam stacks.

summary: Race: Brand+ for permanent strength, Bash+ for vulnerable, use the free FLUTTER turn to attack, block the 17 and 21 hits, and kill within 4 turns before it escapes with a stolen card.
key_turns: T1 THIEVERY 17 + steal: block it, Bash+ for vuln. T2 FLUTTER is free: Brand+/powers then dump attacks. T3 HAT_TRICK 21: full block. Kill by T4 — T5 it escapes with your stolen card.

summary: Setup powers early while incoming is low, scale Strength (Brand+, Fight Me+) for the Insatiable boss, focus-fire one bug at a time, block enrage/mandible turns, save both potions for the boss.
key_turns: T1-T2 incoming is small: play powers, then Brand+/Fight Me+ for permanent Strength. After an ENRAGE, mandibles hit ~9 each; full-block turns where 2-3 attack together.

summary: Set up strength and block on the free turn; block 23/17 hits with Uppercut+/Colossus/Taunt, stack vulnerable for free Bully damage, avoid multi-hits during thorns. Save droplet; regen only if low.
key_turns: T1 free: play powers+strength. On 23 SPIKE_EXPLOSION turn: Uppercut+/Bash+ then Colossus; block 17 with Taunt/Blood Wall. While thorns 5 up, only single-hit attacks (no Twin/Sword/FightMe).

summary: Attrition at 17 HP: Regen early, play Crimson Mantle and Stone Armor for free block, kill Egg then Silk (poison), burst Rock on its self-stun turns; never trade HP.
key_turns: T1 block 22, drink Regen. T2/T4 Rock stunned: burst. T3/T5 headbutt 15 + Silk spit: full block; kill Silk before second spit.

summary: At 38 HP play this as survival: turns 1-2 set up Crimson Mantle, Stone Armor and Brand+ for free recurring block and strength, then focus one exoskeleton down at a time, fully blocking MANDIBLES turns; rock finishes an enemy, droplet stays…
key_turns: Enrage->Mandibles turns: group ~25+ incoming, block fully. Kill one exoskeleton at a time (lowest HP/enrager) to cut damage; don't trade HP at 38/97.

summary: Ignore eggs; kill OVICOPTER. Turn 1 free, deploy Brand+, Fight Me+, Mantle. Block the ~20 SMASH turns plus egg hits, race with strength-scaled multi-hits; hold rock potion for lethal.
key_turns: T1 Summon free: powers. T2 SMASH 19 plus egg hits: block fully. TENDERIZER 7 turn is safe for powers/setup; ignore eggs, race boss.

summary: Use the free goop turn for Fight Me+, Brand+, Crimson Mantle, Stone Armor. Then block every 21 Puncture fully and the 17 Bites most turns, chipping with strength-boosted Twin Strike/Sword Boomerang/Bully; finish by ~turn 6-7.
key_turns: T1 goop deals 0: deploy powers. Puncture 21 turns need full block (Blood Wall, Colossus after Uppercut+/Bash+). On Tender turns play few cards; block 17 Bites while chipping.

summary: Race with permanent strength: free turns deploy Fight Me+, Brand+, Crimson Mantle, Stone Armor; other turns swing multi-hit attacks with Bash/Taunt vulnerability. Play each affordable Frantic Escape once; rock potion for final burst.
key_turns: Free no-attack turns (Liquify, Salivate): deploy powers; play every affordable Frantic Escape at once - clock kills at sandpit 0. Block 29 Lunging Bite with Taunt/Colossus (vulnerable) plus blocks.

summary: Deploy Fight Me+/Brand+/Crimson Mantle turn 1 for permanent strength, kill Turret Operator first (rock potion to finish it), then out-scale Living Shield's 25 block; block on UNLOAD/SMASH turns. HP 113 makes this safe.
key_turns: T3-4: Turret's UNLOAD 16 and Shield's SMASH 16; block or kill Turret then. T1-2 deploy powers, ~21 incoming is affordable at 113 HP.

summary: Only 172 HP but damage ramps +9/turn, so race: stack permanent strength turn 1 (Fight Me+, Brand+, Mantle), Bash+ then multi-hits every turn, kill by turn 4-5; hold rock potion for the finishing turn.
key_turns: Turn 1 is free (Buff) — deploy all powers. SAVAGE grows 12→21→30→39: apply Bash+ vulnerability, then Colossus/block on turn 4, or finish it that turn.

summary: Turn 1 is free, so deploy Fight Me+, Crimson Mantle, Rupture and Brand+ for permanent strength. Focus one Cubex; spend both rock potions to finish it fast. Taunt/Bash first to strip Artifact, then weak/vulnerable; block hard on Repeater an…
key_turns: T1 no attacks: play powers. T2/T4 double Repeater 9x2-11x2 + Punch ~45: full block, Colossus/Uppercut weak. EXPEL 22 turn: big block. Rocks finish Cubex #1 by ~T3.

summary: Turn 1 is free: deploy Rupture, Inferno, Crimson Mantle. Focus The Lost; AOE chips Forgotten. Self-damage stacks strength and triggers 6 AOE; hold rocks for kill turns, block the big DREAD+laser turn.
key_turns: Smog turn applies Weak; when DREAD 16 + EYE_LASERS 13 line up, full block with Blood Wall/Colossus/Taunt. Kill Lost before its strength ramps.

summary: Turns 1-2 deploy Rupture, Inferno, Crimson Mantle behind enough block; self-damage triggers then stack Strength and deal AOE each turn, melting Fabricator and any summons. Keep HP for the Queen boss.
key_turns: Block fully on the 17-18 FABRICATING_STRIKE turns; DISINTEGRATE/FABRICATE turns are setup windows — play powers and dump attacks into Fabricator; Inferno AOE chips summons.

summary: Setup powers behind block on Chain turns: Rupture + Inferno turn every HP loss into AOE and strength, Fight Me+ for permanent strength. Burn both Rock potions to finish Amalgam, then Queen with weakness on her 42/25 turns.
key_turns: T1-T2 Queen does not attack: play one power each (chains limit one chained card/turn). Amalgam hits 25-26 every turn - block it. Kill Amalgam ~T5-6. Then block OFF_WITH_YOUR_HEAD 42 and EXECUTION 25 …

summary: Play Inferno turn 1: 1 HP per turn and Offering's 6 HP each deal 6 damage to trigger. Then race the 47 HP punk, blocking its 11/9 kicks; keep HP high for the act. Save thorns potion for a multi-hit fight.
key_turns: Block the 11 and 9 attack turns; the 0-damage BUBBLE_BURP turn is free — attack then. Expect the kill by T4.

summary: Inferno then Offering turn 1, AoE both, burst the 23 HP buffing toadpole, block the 7. Turn 2 the survivor only buffs — finish with Bash+Strike. Save Liquid Bronze for the boss.
key_turns: Kill the Buffing toadpole first (so spikes never land); block the incoming 7. Turn 2 the other one only buffs — kill it before any Spike Spit 9s.

summary: Inferno turn 1 converts every self-damage into 6 AoE. Use the HEHE buff turn for Offering and burst damage. Block the 16-damage GIMME turn; keep both potions for the boss.
key_turns: T1 DOUBLE_SMASH 16: play Inferno, block some. T2 HEHE is a free damage turn: Offering plus full attacks. T3 GIMME 16: full block, then finish it.

summary: Open Inferno+Offering for 6 AoE/turn, cards and Century Puzzle draw; Bash then Bludgeon into vulnerable, kill by turn 4-5; save Ritual potion and HP for the Waterfall Giant boss.
key_turns: Turns 3-5: BLOAT buff makes SUPER_GAS_BLAST hit harder; block 10-15 then. Bash first (vulnerable), Bludgeon next turn for ~48; kill before strength stacks.

summary: Play Inferno turn 1: every self-damage (turn start, Offering) deals 6 AoE to both enemies; Offering also draws via Century Puzzle and makes Spite a free 10. Kill Cultist first; save Ritual for Waterfall Giant.
key_turns: T1 Cultist buffs, only Seapunk hits 11: play Inferno then Offering. Turns 3-5 both attack (~21): Colossus plus Flame Barrier. Kill Cultist before its Ritual stacks.

summary: Drink both potions turn 1; play Inferno+ then Offering on the free buff turn, race with Bash vulnerability, Bludgeon and Spite, block Pressure Gun turns fully, and keep enough block for the ~40 explosion.
key_turns: T1 is a free buff turn: powers/Offering. Fully block Pressure Gun turns (T5 20 / T10 25); kill ~T8-T9, then fully block the ~40 EXPLODE. Never sit below eruption stacks.

summary: Race it: turn 1 Inferno+ then Offering (9 AoE per HP loss, Spite double-hits). T2 break the 32 burrow block while it is harmless; then kill through BELOW 23 with light blocking. Kill by turn 4-5, save HP for the boss.
key_turns: T2 BURROW: gains 32 persistent block and does not attack — dump all damage to break it now. After that BELOW 23 every turn: cap with Colossus/Taunt/Flame Barrier but keep racing.

summary: Turn 1: Inferno+, Inferno, Offering — every self-damage fires AoE (15 per turn start) melting all three; Spite becomes 10. Keep block on mandible turns; race the ENRAGE stacking. Vulnerable potion saved for Kaiser Crab.
key_turns: Turn 1: play both Infernos then Offering (HP loss fires AoE on all three). Turn-start AoE + Spite double-hit carry; block on multi-mandible turns. Don't drag past ~4 turns, ENRAGE stacks.

summary: Open with both Inferno powers plus Offering so every self-damage hits both Chompers for 15; Whirlwind/Spite/Bludgeon race one down, block CLAMP turns, never waste vulnerable into 2 artifact stacks.
key_turns: T1-T2 stack Inferno+, Inferno, Offering; block the 8x2 CLAMP turns, attack freely on SCREECH turns; second Offering only to close lethal. Kill one Chomper by T3.

summary: At 26 HP race: turn 1 Inferno+ and Inferno, then Offering (each self-damage fires 15 AoE); Vulnerable potion early to amplify; Swift potion only to dig for block when POUNCE would kill. Never end turn under 21.
key_turns: Turn 2-3: POUNCE 20 and WEB_CANNON 12+vulnerable; fully block those (Colossus under Vulnerable, Flame Barrier, Taunt). Kill by turn 4-5 before its second CURL_AND_GROW.

summary: Double Inferno: every self-damage or thorns hit deals 15 AoE and doubles Spite. Race to kill by T3-T4, blocking 23/17. Save the Energy potion for Kaiser Crab's burst turn.
key_turns: T1 free Buff turn: powers then Offering, burst. T2 block 23, T3 block 17 or kill. T4+ thorns 5: prefer single hits (thorns HP loss also feeds Inferno).

summary: Double Inferno engine: T1 Inferno+, Inferno, Offering (6 HP fires 15 AoE to both, draws via relic). Then race with Spite/Whirlwind; focus the 64-HP Myte that bites T2. Keep Tincture for kill turn, Speed only if dying.
key_turns: T1 only 4 incoming — full setup. T2 BITE 14, T3 ~18: block those, else attack. Expect both Mytes down by T5-T6.

summary: Both Infernos down in the first 1-2 turns for free AoE; block fully every turn, aim single-target damage at bowlbugs (beetle's plating wastes it). Then grind the beetle with vulnerable + Taunt/Colossus halving; Offering only for a kill.
key_turns: T1 block Rock's 15 fully; T2 both bugs hit ~23 — Speed potion if uncovered. Beetle wakes ~T4: roll-outs 19+ — Taunt+Colossus halves them, keep vulnerable up.

summary: Opening turn is free damage and status pollution starts immediately; race it down in ~4 turns, Bash+ first for vulnerable, accept small HP loss but never skip blocking a full 12-13 hit.
Block to keep HP loss minimal, then chip through Plating steadily; no need to trade HP in a single-enemy normal fight. Keep damage potion saved for the boss.
End it in about three turns: apply Vulnerable, pour in frontloaded damage, use the 5-block attacks as light cover, and don't let SUCK scale into large hits. HP floor stays roughly at 50.
At 30 HP, end this in under 4 turns: block enough to stay safe, then kill one slug at a time, attackers before the debuffer, so incoming damage and their healing stop early.
Take the two free turns for full damage, then kill as fast as possible; block only where cheap, and do not let the 23/turn slashes pile up past five turns.
Short fight before the boss: frontload all damage, break it in one or two turns, keep HP near 85% for Vantom; no reserved potions.
Take the free summon turn for full damage, then burn the main body fast with attacks and multi-hit; keep enough block only for its 16-damage hits, ignore any summons.
Strip 9 Slippery fast with multi-hit attacks, then push ~23+ damage each turn to end Vantom before the second Dismember; full block only on Dismember turns.
Neutralize 84 HP in ~3 turns with frontloaded multi-hit attacks; block the big hits only as needed, keep HP for the boss in 14 floors. Kill before it escapes with stolen cards.
Clear all three with AOE, finishing the weakest first so attackers drop off; use the buffing turn to deal damage and set up Strength, killing within about three turns.
112 HP across three bugs. Frontload AOE/multi-hit so the Egg dies and Silk/Rock drop low, then finish survivors within ~3 turns; only block the 15 headbutt.
Near-full HP hallway: frontload AOE and multi-hit to clear the four weak bugs fast, focus fire one at a time, keep block on the attackers, and stay near 85% HP for the act boss.
Frontload everything into the main body — when it dies the eggs vanish. Trade a little HP to end it within a few turns, blocking just enough to blunt the big smash.
